# FILE: tests/test_bluetooth.py
================================================================================
"""ESPHome nodes lending their Bluetooth as sources of the hub's Bluetooth router."""

import asyncio
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, cast
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from aioesphomeapi import (
    APIClient,
    APIConnectionError,
    BluetoothLERawAdvertisementsResponse,
    BluetoothProxyFeature,
    DeviceInfo,
)
from aioesphomeapi.model import APIVersion, BluetoothGATTService, ESPHomeBluetoothGATTServices
from majordom_integration_sdk import Endpoint, Platform
from majordom_integration_sdk.capabilities import BLEDiscoveryInfo, BLERouter
from majordom_integration_sdk.peripherals import BLEProxy, Peripherals
from majordom_integration_sdk.repository.memory import DeviceRepositoryMemory
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime import PeripheralState, Runtime
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime.peripherals.providers.ble.router import BLEService
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime.peripherals.providers.zeroconf import ZeroconfDiscoveryService
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Discovery
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import FakePeripheral, RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome.bluetooth import ESPhomeBLEConnection, ESPhomeBLESource, ble_source_of
from majordom_esphome.connection import WAIT_READY_TIMEOUT, ESPhomeDeviceConnection
from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import assert_not_paired, hub_creates_device, leaked_tasks, wait_until
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS

PROXY = (
    BluetoothProxyFeature.PASSIVE_SCAN
    | BluetoothProxyFeature.ACTIVE_CONNECTIONS
    | BluetoothProxyFeature.REMOTE_CACHING
    | BluetoothProxyFeature.RAW_ADVERTISEMENTS
)
MATTER = "0000fff6-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb"
DEVICE = 0xAABBCCDDEEFF
MATTER_ADV = bytes.fromhex("0b16f6ff00000fa1f7ff0180")  # service data: a commissionable Matter device
NAME = bytes.fromhex("0509") + b"Bulb"  # scan response: complete local name
TX_POWER = bytes.fromhex("020a08")  # 8 dBm
NODES = {"kitchen": "11:22:33:44:55:01", "garage": "11:22:33:44:55:02"}  # node name -> its Bluetooth MAC


class FakeAPIClient:
    api_version: APIVersion | None = APIVersion(1, 12)

    def __init__(
        self,
        features: int = PROXY,
        answers: tuple[bool, int, int] = (True, 247, 0),
        mac: str = "11:22:33:44:55:66",
        device_info_error: Exception | None = None,
        unsubscribe_error: Exception | None = None,
    ):
        self.features, self.answers, self.mac = features, answers, mac
        self.device_info_error, self.unsubscribe_error = device_info_error, unsubscribe_error
        self.on_advertisements: Callable[[BluetoothLERawAdvertisementsResponse], None] | None = None
        self.on_stop: Callable[[bool], Awaitable[None]] | None = None
        self.disconnected = False
        self.writes: list[tuple[int, bytes]] = []
        self.descriptors: list[tuple[int, bytes]] = []
        self.on_notify: Callable[[int, bytearray], None] | None = None
        self.on_slots: Callable[[int, int, list[int]], None] | None = None
        self.unsubscribed = 0
        self.connected: tuple[int, int | None] | None = None  # the device it connected to, and its address type
        self.on_state: Callable[[bool, int, int], None] | None = None  # of the device it connected to
        self.notifying: set[int] = set()
        self.disconnects: list[int] = []

    async def device_info(self) -> DeviceInfo:
        if self.device_info_error:
            raise self.device_info_error
        return DeviceInfo.from_dict({"mac_address": self.mac, "bluetooth_proxy_feature_flags": self.features})

    def subscribe_bluetooth_le_raw_advertisements(
        self, callback: Callable[[BluetoothLERawAdvertisementsResponse], None]
    ) -> Callable[[], None]:
        self.on_advertisements = callback

        def unsubscribe():
            self.on_advertisements = None
            self.unsubscribed += 1
            if self.unsubscribe_error:
                raise self.unsubscribe_error

        return unsubscribe

    def subscribe_bluetooth_connections_free(
        self, callback: Callable[[int, int, list[int]], None]
    ) -> Callable[[], None]:
        self.on_slots = callback

        def unsubscribe():
            self.on_slots = None

        return unsubscribe

    # what the device connection asks of a node besides Bluetooth
    async def connect(self, login: bool, on_stop: Callable[[bool], Awaitable[None]]):
        self.on_stop = on_stop

    async def list_entities_services(self) -> tuple[list[Any], list[Any]]:
        return [], []

    def subscribe_states(self, callback: Callable[[Any], None]): ...

    async def disconnect(self):
        self.disconnected = True

    async def drop(self):
        assert self.on_stop
        await self.on_stop(False)

    def advertise(self, data: bytes, rssi: int = -60):
        response = BluetoothLERawAdvertisementsResponse()
        response.advertisements.add(address=DEVICE, rssi=rssi, address_type=1, data=data)
        assert self.on_advertisements
        self.on_advertisements(response)

    async def bluetooth_device_connect(
        self,
        address: int,
        on_state: Callable[[bool, int, int], None],
        feature_flags: int = 0,
        address_type: int | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Callable[[], None]:
        self.connected = (address, address_type)
        self.on_state = on_state
        on_state(*self.answers)

        def unsubscribe():
            self.on_state = None

        return unsubscribe

    async def bluetooth_gatt_get_services(self, address: int) -> ESPHomeBluetoothGATTServices:
        cccd = {"uuid": "00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb", "handle": 6}
        characteristics = [
            {"uuid": "c1", "handle": 3, "properties": 0x08},
            {"uuid": "c2", "handle": 5, "properties": 0x20, "descriptors": [cccd]},
        ]
        service = BluetoothGATTService.from_dict({"uuid": MATTER, "handle": 1, "characteristics": characteristics})
        # a dataclass made by functools.partial, which ty can't see into
        return ESPHomeBluetoothGATTServices(address, [service])  # ty: ignore[too-many-positional-arguments]

    async def bluetooth_gatt_write(self, address: int, handle: int, data: bytes, response: bool):
        self.writes.append((handle, data))

    async def bluetooth_gatt_read(self, address: int, handle: int) -> bytearray:
        return bytearray(b"value")

    async def bluetooth_gatt_start_notify(
        self, address: int, handle: int, callback: Callable[[int, bytearray], None]
    ) -> tuple[Callable[[], Awaitable[None]], Callable[[], None]]:
        self.on_notify = callback
        self.notifying.add(handle)

        async def stop():
            self.notifying.discard(handle)

        return stop, (lambda: None)

    def bluetooth_gatt_stop_notify_for_address(self, address: int): ...

    async def bluetooth_gatt_write_descriptor(self, address: int, handle: int, data: bytes):
        self.descriptors.append((handle, data))

    async def bluetooth_device_disconnect(self, address: int):
        self.disconnects.append(address)


async def source_of(client: FakeAPIClient) -> ESPhomeBLESource | None:
    return await ble_source_of(cast(APIClient, client))


class Listener:
    def __init__(self):
        self.heard: list[BLEDiscoveryInfo] = []

    async def ble_did_discover_device(self, ble: BLERouter, info: BLEDiscoveryInfo):
        self.heard.append(info)

    ble_did_update_device = ble_did_discover_device

    async def ble_did_remove_device(self, ble: BLERouter, info: BLEDiscoveryInfo): ...


@pytest.fixture
async def ble_and_node() -> AsyncIterator[tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]]:
    client = FakeAPIClient()
    ble = BLEService(sources=[])
    await ble.start()
    source = await source_of(client)
    assert source
    await ble.add_source(source)
    yield ble, client
    await ble.stop()


async def test_only_nodes_streaming_raw_advertisements_are_sources():
    assert await source_of(FakeAPIClient(features=0)) is None
    source = await source_of(FakeAPIClient())
    assert source and source.name == "esphome:11:22:33:44:55:66"


async def test_a_node_that_closed_its_api_connection_meanwhile_lends_nothing():
    client = FakeAPIClient()
    client.api_version = None  # what the client knows once the connection closed

    assert await source_of(client) is None


async def test_advertisements_and_scan_responses_merge_into_one_device(ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})

    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    client.advertise(NAME)
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    first, second = listener.heard  # found, then named; the repeat changed nothing
    assert first.device.address == "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF" and first.source == "esphome:11:22:33:44:55:66"
    assert second.advertisement.local_name == "Bulb"
    assert second.advertisement.service_data == {MATTER: bytes.fromhex("00000fa1f7ff0180")}


async def test_a_scan_response_keeps_the_tx_power_its_advertisement_carried(
    ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient],
):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})

    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV + TX_POWER)
    client.advertise(NAME)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    assert [info.advertisement.tx_power for info in listener.heard] == [8, 8]


async def test_connects_and_speaks_gatt_by_handle(ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    connection = await ble.connect("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF")
    assert client.connected == (DEVICE, 1) and connection.mtu == 247
    services = await connection.services()
    assert [(c.uuid, c.properties) for c in services[0].characteristics] == [("c1", ("write",)), ("c2", ("indicate",))]

    await connection.write(3, b"hs")
    notes = []
    await connection.start_notify(5, notes.append)
    assert client.on_notify
    client.on_notify(5, bytearray(b"ok"))
    assert client.writes == [(3, b"hs")] and client.descriptors == [(6, b"\x02\x00")] and notes == [b"ok"]


async def test_a_closed_connection_leaves_no_notify_handler_on_the_node():
    """The library cleans a device's notify handlers up only once told it disconnected, which the connection stops
    listening for as it disconnects: a handler left behind would feed a later connection to the same handle."""
    handlers: list[Callable[..., None]] = []

    class NodeConnection:  # what the real client talks through
        is_connected = True

        def add_message_callback(self, callback: Callable[..., None], types: Any) -> Callable[[], None]:
            handlers.append(callback)
            return lambda: handlers.remove(callback)

        def send_message(self, message: Any): ...

    class Client(APIClient):
        def _get_connection(self) -> Any:
            return NodeConnection()

    client = Client("node", 6053, None)
    client._send_bluetooth_message_await_response = AsyncMock()
    client._bluetooth_device_request = AsyncMock()
    connection = ESPhomeBLEConnection(client, DEVICE, 247, lambda: None)
    characteristic = {"uuid": "c", "handle": 5}
    connection._services = [
        BluetoothGATTService.from_dict({"uuid": MATTER, "handle": 1, "characteristics": [characteristic]})
    ]
    await connection.start_notify(5, lambda data: None)

    await connection.disconnect()

    assert handlers == []


async def test_a_proxied_connection_reads_stops_notifying_and_disconnects(
    ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient],
):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    connection = await ble.connect("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF")

    assert await connection.read(3) == b"value"
    await connection.start_notify(5, lambda data: None)
    await connection.stop_notify(5)
    assert client.notifying == set()
    await connection.disconnect()
    assert client.on_state is None and client.disconnects == [DEVICE]


async def test_a_device_dropping_its_proxied_connection_is_told(ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    dropped: list[bool] = []
    await ble.connect("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF", on_disconnect=lambda: dropped.append(True))

    assert client.on_state
    client.on_state(False, 0, 0x13)  # the device went away

    assert dropped == [True]


async def test_notifying_an_unknown_handle_is_a_lookup_error(ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    connection = await ble.connect("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF")

    with pytest.raises(LookupError):
        await connection.start_notify(99, lambda data: None)


async def test_a_refused_connection_is_an_error(ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    client.answers = (False, 0, 133)
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="error 133"):
        await ble.connect("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF")


async def test_a_leased_node_stays_subscribed_but_mutes_its_advertisements(
    ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient],
):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    async with ble.exclusive("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF", owner="matter") as lease:
        assert client.on_advertisements, "the node answers connects only to its subscriber"
        client.advertise(NAME)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        assert len(listener.heard) == 1
        await lease.connect()
        assert client.connected == (DEVICE, 1)
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    assert listener.heard[-1].advertisement.local_name == "Bulb"  # heard again, the muted name kept


async def test_a_lease_mutes_a_lent_node_and_resumes_it_without_unsubscribing():
    """A node lent through its proxy, as the runtime binds it: a lease pauses it (it stays subscribed, or it would
    refuse the leaseholder's connect) and the release resumes it."""
    client = FakeAPIClient()
    source = await source_of(client)
    assert source
    ble = BLEService()
    ble.peripherals = Peripherals({"ble": [*BLEProxy(source).provides]})
    await ble.start()
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    subscribed = client.on_advertisements

    async with ble.exclusive("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF", owner="matter") as lease:
        assert lease.source == source.name
        client.advertise(MATTER_ADV, rssi=-30)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        assert len(listener.heard) == 1  # muted
        assert client.on_advertisements is subscribed
    client.advertise(NAME)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    assert len(listener.heard) == 2  # resumed
    assert client.on_advertisements is subscribed and client.unsubscribed == 0
    await ble.stop()


async def test_a_node_hears_again_after_a_router_restart_cut_its_lease_short():
    """The router stops while the node is leased (a restart, a failed hook): the release can't resume it then."""
    client = FakeAPIClient()
    source = await source_of(client)
    assert source
    ble = BLEService(sources=[source])
    await ble.start()
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})

    async with ble.exclusive("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF", owner="esphome-improv"):
        await ble.stop()
    await ble.start()
    client.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    assert len(listener.heard) == 1, "a started source hears"
    await ble.stop()


async def test_a_node_reconnecting_while_its_radio_is_leased_hears_once_released():
    """Its API connection drops during the lease (Matter commissioning through it): ESPHome takes the radio back, then
    lends the one of the new connection under the same name."""
    first = FakeAPIClient()
    old = await source_of(first)
    assert old
    ble = BLEService(sources=[old])
    await ble.start()
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})
    first.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    async with ble.exclusive("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF", owner="matter"):
        await ble.remove_source(old.name)
        second = FakeAPIClient()
        new = await source_of(second)
        assert new
        await ble.add_source(new)
        assert second.on_advertisements, "the node answers the lease's connects only to its subscriber"
        second.advertise(NAME)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        assert len(listener.heard) == 1, "muted while leased"
    second.advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    assert len(listener.heard) == 2
    await ble.stop()


async def test_a_quiet_node_stays_subscribed(ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]):
    """A node in a quiet place hears no one for a while; its loss shows through its API connection, and resubscribing
    it would drop the replies of the connections it proxies."""
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    subscribed = client.on_advertisements
    ble._silence_sec = 0.01
    await asyncio.sleep(0.02)

    await ble._revive_silent()

    assert client.on_advertisements is subscribed and client.unsubscribed == 0


async def test_a_node_says_how_many_connections_it_can_still_open(ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient]):
    _, client = ble_and_node
    source = await source_of(client)
    assert source
    await source.start(lambda device, adv: None)
    assert source.free_slots is None  # until the node says
    assert client.on_slots
    client.on_slots(1, 3, [0xAABBCCDDEEFF, 0x112233445566])
    assert source.free_slots == 1
    await source.stop()
    assert client.on_slots is None


async def test_a_node_that_only_listens_has_no_slots_to_report():
    client = FakeAPIClient(features=BluetoothProxyFeature.PASSIVE_SCAN | BluetoothProxyFeature.RAW_ADVERTISEMENTS)
    source = await source_of(client)
    assert source
    await source.start(lambda device, adv: None)
    assert client.on_slots is None


async def test_rotating_addresses_dont_grow_the_memory(
    ble_and_node: tuple[BLEService, FakeAPIClient], monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    ble, client = ble_and_node
    monkeypatch.setattr("majordom_esphome.bluetooth._REMEMBERED", 2)
    source = ble._sources["esphome:11:22:33:44:55:66"]
    assert isinstance(source, ESPhomeBLESource) and client.on_advertisements
    for address in range(3):
        response = BluetoothLERawAdvertisementsResponse()
        response.advertisements.add(address=address, rssi=-60, address_type=1, data=MATTER_ADV)
        client.on_advertisements(response)
    assert list(source._heard) == ["00:00:00:00:00:01", "00:00:00:00:00:02"]


class Nodes:
    """Stands for `APIClient` where the device connections open one: each node the hub connects to is a fake."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.clients: list[FakeAPIClient] = []
        self.options: dict[str, Any] = {}  # what the nodes are like from now on: features, device_info_error, …

    def __call__(self, address: str, port: int, password: str | None, noise_psk: str | None = None) -> FakeAPIClient:
        self.clients.append(FakeAPIClient(mac=NODES[address.removesuffix(".local")], **self.options))
        return self.clients[-1]

    def connection_of(self, node: str) -> FakeAPIClient:
        """The newest connection to the node."""
        return next(client for client in reversed(self.clients) if client.mac == NODES[node])


def lent(node: str) -> str:
    return f"esphome:{NODES[node]}"


def sources(ble: BLEService) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(ble._sources)


def proxies(runtime: Runtime) -> list[str]:
    return [p.key for p in runtime.peripherals if isinstance(p, BLEProxy)]


def zeroconf_of(runtime: Runtime) -> ZeroconfDiscoveryService:
    (zeroconf,) = [p for p in runtime.peripherals if isinstance(p, ZeroconfDiscoveryService)]
    return zeroconf


@pytest.fixture
def ble() -> BLEService:
    """The Hub's Bluetooth router: the runtime runs it while ESPHome binds it."""
    return BLEService()


@pytest.fixture
def nodes(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Nodes:
    nodes = Nodes()
    monkeypatch.setattr("majordom_esphome.connection.APIClient", nodes)
    monkeypatch.setattr("majordom_esphome.connection.RECONNECT_DELAY_FIRST", 0.3)
    return nodes


@pytest.fixture
def settings() -> ESPhomeController.Settings:
    return ESPhomeController.Settings()


@pytest.fixture
async def runtime(
    platform: Platform,
    settings: ESPhomeController.Settings,
    ble: BLEService,
    nodes: Nodes,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> AsyncIterator[Runtime]:
    """ESPHome run as by the Hub, beside the Bluetooth router and DNS-SD it binds."""
    peripherals = [ble, ZeroconfDiscoveryService(), ESPhomeController(platform, settings=settings)]
    runtime = Runtime(tmp_path / "data", peripherals, platform=platform, controller_output=output)
    await runtime.start()
    await wait_until(lambda: all(runtime.status(p).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING for p in runtime.peripherals))
    yield runtime
    await runtime.stop()


@pytest.fixture
def esphome(runtime: Runtime) -> ESPhomeController:
    (controller,) = [p for p in runtime.peripherals if isinstance(p, ESPhomeController)]
    return controller


async def announce(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: str) -> Discovery:
    mac = NODES[node].replace(":", "")
    await mdns.announce(Advert(name=node, mac=mac, server=f"{node}.local.", addresses=[]))
    return controller.discoveries[controller.device_uuid(mac)]


async def pair(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: str) -> ESPhomeDevice:
    discovery = await announce(controller, mdns, node)
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, discovery, name=node)
    await controller.pair_device(discovery, None)
    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        device = await repo.get(discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert device is not None
    return device


async def test_a_paired_node_with_a_proxy_lends_its_radio(
    esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})

    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent")
    nodes.connection_of("kitchen").advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)

    assert [info.source for info in listener.heard] == [lent("kitchen")]


async def test_a_lent_radio_is_a_proxy_esphome_brings_along(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes
):
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: len(esphome.provides) == 1, message="the node to be lent")

    proxy = runtime.peripheral(f"esphome/{NODES['kitchen']}")  # known by its Bluetooth MAC
    assert isinstance(proxy, BLEProxy) and proxy.contributor is esphome
    assert runtime.status(proxy).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING


def test_the_setting_is_on_by_default():
    assert ESPhomeController.Settings().is_bluetooth_proxy_enabled is True


async def test_a_node_without_a_proxy_lends_nothing(
    esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    nodes.options["features"] = 0

    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

    assert sources(ble) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("settings", [ESPhomeController.Settings(is_bluetooth_proxy_enabled=False)])
async def test_nothing_is_lent_while_the_setting_is_off(
    esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

    assert sources(ble) == [] and esphome.provides == []


async def test_turning_the_proxies_off_restarts_it_and_takes_every_radio_back(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent")
    first = nodes.connection_of("kitchen")

    await runtime.update_settings(esphome, {"is_bluetooth_proxy_enabled": False})

    await wait_until(lambda: nodes.connection_of("kitchen") is not first, message="the node to reconnect")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    assert sources(ble) == [] and proxies(runtime) == []


async def test_unpairing_a_node_takes_back_only_its_radio(
    esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    kitchen = await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "garage")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen"), lent("garage")], message="both nodes to be lent")

    await esphome.unpair(kitchen)

    assert sources(ble) == [lent("garage")]
    assert nodes.connection_of("kitchen").on_advertisements is None


async def test_a_node_that_drops_is_taken_back_and_lent_once_when_it_returns(
    esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent")
    dropped = nodes.connection_of("kitchen")

    await dropped.drop()
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [], message="the dropped node to be taken back")
    assert dropped.on_advertisements is None

    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent again")
    assert nodes.connection_of("kitchen") is not dropped and dropped.on_advertisements is None


async def test_stop_takes_back_every_radio(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "garage")
    await wait_until(lambda: len(sources(ble)) == 2, message="both nodes to be lent")

    await runtime.disable(esphome)

    assert proxies(runtime) == [] and esphome.provides == []
    assert all(client.on_advertisements is None and client.disconnected for client in nodes.clients)
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_restarted_controller_lends_each_node_once(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    listener = Listener()
    ble.register(listener, {UUID(MATTER)})
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent")
    first = nodes.connection_of("kitchen")

    await runtime.restart(esphome)

    await wait_until(lambda: nodes.connection_of("kitchen") is not first, message="the node to reconnect")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent again")
    nodes.connection_of("kitchen").advertise(MATTER_ADV)
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    assert first.on_advertisements is None and len(listener.heard) == 1


async def test_a_failed_pairing_leaves_no_radio_lent(
    esphome: ESPhomeController,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    nodes: Nodes,
    ble: BLEService,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
):
    discovery = await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await hub_creates_device(esphome.platform, discovery, name="kitchen")
    # the pairing fails after connecting, once the node is lent
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        output, "controller_did_connect_device", AsyncMock(side_effect=RuntimeError("the Hub went away"))
    )

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        await esphome.pair_device(discovery, None)

    assert sources(ble) == []
    assert nodes.connection_of("kitchen").on_advertisements is None
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_pairing_that_failed_once_connected_can_be_tried_again(
    esphome: ESPhomeController,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    nodes: Nodes,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
):
    discovery = await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await hub_creates_device(esphome.platform, discovery, name="kitchen")
    with monkeypatch.context() as hub:
        hub.setattr(output, "controller_did_connect_device", AsyncMock(side_effect=RuntimeError("the Hub went away")))
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            await esphome.pair_device(discovery, None)

    await esphome.pair_device(esphome.discoveries[discovery.id], None)

    assert output.connected_devices == [discovery.id]
    assert [client.disconnected for client in nodes.clients] == [True, False]


async def test_a_node_whose_bluetooth_fails_to_set_up_stays_connected(
    esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    nodes.options["device_info_error"] = APIConnectionError("the node went quiet")

    device = await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

    assert device.available and output.lost_devices == []
    assert sources(ble) == []


async def test_stop_finishes_when_a_radio_cannot_be_taken_back(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    nodes.options["unsubscribe_error"] = RuntimeError("the node is gone")
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent")

    await runtime.disable(esphome)

    assert nodes.connection_of("kitchen").disconnected
    assert proxies(runtime) == [] and leaked_tasks() == []


# A stop meeting a pairing in flight


@pytest.fixture
def slow_nodes(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> asyncio.Event:
    """The nodes list their entities only once it is set: a pairing waits for its node meanwhile."""
    answered = asyncio.Event()

    async def list_entities_services(self: FakeAPIClient) -> tuple[list[Any], list[Any]]:
        await answered.wait()
        return [], []

    monkeypatch.setattr(FakeAPIClient, "list_entities_services", list_entities_services)
    return answered


async def start_pairing(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, node: str
) -> tuple[Discovery, asyncio.Task[UUID | None]]:
    """The user pairs the node; returns once the pairing waits for it."""
    discovery = await announce(controller, mdns, node)
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, discovery, name=node)
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(controller.pair_device(discovery, None))
    await wait_until(lambda: nodes.clients and nodes.clients[-1].on_stop, message="the node to answer the connect")
    return discovery, pairing


async def test_a_pairing_that_outlives_a_stop_is_refused_and_leaves_nothing_behind(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, slow_nodes: asyncio.Event
):
    discovery, pairing = await start_pairing(esphome, mdns, nodes, "kitchen")

    await runtime.disable(esphome)
    slow_nodes.set()

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="stopped"):
        await pairing
    assert esphome._connections == {} and nodes.connection_of("kitchen").disconnected
    await assert_not_paired(esphome.platform, discovery.id)
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_pairing_across_a_restart_is_refused_and_lends_nothing(
    runtime: Runtime,
    esphome: ESPhomeController,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    nodes: Nodes,
    ble: BLEService,
    slow_nodes: asyncio.Event,
):
    """The user turns the proxies off (another hub needs the node's Bluetooth) while the node is paired: the pairing,
    made with the proxies on, finishes once ESPHome runs again."""
    discovery, pairing = await start_pairing(esphome, mdns, nodes, "kitchen")

    await runtime.update_settings(esphome, {"is_bluetooth_proxy_enabled": False})
    await wait_until(lambda: runtime.status(esphome).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING, message="ESPHome to run")
    slow_nodes.set()

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="stopped"):
        await pairing
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    assert sources(ble) == [] and esphome.provides == []
    assert esphome._connections == {} and nodes.connection_of("kitchen").disconnected
    await assert_not_paired(esphome.platform, discovery.id)


async def test_a_stop_while_the_device_is_saved_refuses_the_pairing(
    runtime: Runtime,
    esphome: ESPhomeController,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    nodes: Nodes,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
):
    discovery = await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await hub_creates_device(esphome.platform, discovery, name="kitchen")
    save = DeviceRepositoryMemory.save

    async def save_then_stop(self: DeviceRepositoryMemory, device: Any, previous_id: UUID | None = None):
        await save(self, device, previous_id)
        if isinstance(device, ESPhomeDevice) and device.parameters is not None and device.available:
            await runtime.disable(esphome)  # the pairing's own save: the device is complete

    monkeypatch.setattr(DeviceRepositoryMemory, "save", save_then_stop)

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="stopped"):
        await esphome.pair_device(discovery, None)
    assert esphome._connections == {} and nodes.connection_of("kitchen").disconnected
    assert output.connected_devices == [] and leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_stop_reaching_a_node_connection_from_inside_it_ends_it(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    """A node drops while the runtime is busy: its connection task tells the runtime its radio is gone and waits for
    the runtime to act, which stops ESPHome (the Hub removed DNS-SD meanwhile). That stop ends the waiting task too."""
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent")
    opened = len(nodes.clients)

    async with runtime._lock:  # the runtime is busy
        await nodes.connection_of("kitchen").drop()
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        removing = asyncio.create_task(runtime.remove(zeroconf_of(runtime)))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    await removing

    await wait_until(lambda: runtime.status(esphome).state == PeripheralState.WAITING, message="ESPHome to stop")
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # past the reconnect delay
    assert esphome._connections == {} and len(nodes.clients) == opened, "a stopped controller doesn't reconnect"
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_node_lends_its_radio_only_once_it_is_paired(
    runtime: Runtime,
    esphome: ESPhomeController,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    nodes: Nodes,
    ble: BLEService,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
):
    held = asyncio.Event()
    wait_ready = ESPhomeDeviceConnection.wait_ready

    async def wait_ready_then_hold(self: ESPhomeDeviceConnection, timeout: float = WAIT_READY_TIMEOUT):
        await wait_ready(self, timeout)
        await held.wait()  # the node is connected, its pairing not done yet

    monkeypatch.setattr(ESPhomeDeviceConnection, "wait_ready", wait_ready_then_hold)
    discovery = await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await hub_creates_device(esphome.platform, discovery, name="kitchen")
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(esphome.pair_device(discovery, None))
    await wait_until(lambda: nodes.clients and nodes.clients[-1].on_stop, message="the node to answer the connect")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)

    assert sources(ble) == [] and esphome.provides == [], "a node being paired serves no one yet"
    held.set()
    await pairing
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the paired node to be lent")


async def test_a_cancelled_pairing_lets_go_of_the_node(
    runtime: Runtime,
    esphome: ESPhomeController,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    nodes: Nodes,
    ble: BLEService,
    slow_nodes: asyncio.Event,
):
    discovery, pairing = await start_pairing(esphome, mdns, nodes, "kitchen")

    pairing.cancel()  # the Hub's request went away
    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await pairing
    slow_nodes.set()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)

    assert nodes.connection_of("kitchen").disconnected and sources(ble) == []
    await assert_not_paired(esphome.platform, discovery.id)
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


# DNS-SD going away or restarting under it


async def test_dns_sd_removed_first_still_lets_it_stop_cleanly(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent")

    await runtime.remove(zeroconf_of(runtime))  # stopped before ESPHome, its registration gone with it

    await wait_until(lambda: runtime.status(esphome).state == PeripheralState.WAITING, message="ESPHome to stop")
    assert esphome._connections == {} and nodes.connection_of("kitchen").disconnected
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_nodes_are_heard_after_dns_sd_restarts(runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await runtime.restart(zeroconf_of(runtime))
    await wait_until(lambda: runtime.status(esphome).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING, message="ESPHome to run")

    assert await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen"), "a node announced after the restart is discovered"


# Discoveries across a stop


async def test_a_stopped_controller_offers_nothing_to_pair(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes
):
    discovery = await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    await hub_creates_device(esphome.platform, discovery, name="kitchen")

    await runtime.disable(esphome)

    assert esphome.discoveries == {}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no longer discovered"):
        await esphome.pair_device(discovery, None)
    assert esphome._connections == {} and nodes.clients == []
    assert esphome.discoveries == {}, "not even with the reason it failed"


async def test_a_restarted_controller_reports_what_it_hears_again(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")

    await runtime.restart(esphome)
    await wait_until(lambda: runtime.status(esphome).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING, message="ESPHome to run")
    await announce(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")  # heard anew

    assert len(output.received_discoveries) == 2


async def test_a_paired_node_heard_while_it_starts_is_no_discovery(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    """On a restart DNS-SD's cache is warm: it tells the nodes it knows at once, maybe before the paired devices are
    read (a busy database at boot)."""
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    get_all = DeviceRepositoryMemory.get_all

    async def slow_get_all(self: DeviceRepositoryMemory, as_: Any = None) -> Any:
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        return await get_all(self, as_)

    monkeypatch.setattr(DeviceRepositoryMemory, "get_all", slow_get_all)
    kitchen = Advert(name="kitchen", mac=NODES["kitchen"].replace(":", ""), server="kitchen.local.", addresses=[])

    restarting = asyncio.create_task(runtime.restart(esphome))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    await mdns.announce(kitchen)
    await restarting
    await mdns.announce(kitchen)

    assert esphome.discoveries == {}, "picking it would open a second connection to the node"


# Routers coming later


async def test_a_bluetooth_router_starting_later_is_taken_in_place(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes, ble: BLEService
):
    await runtime.disable(ble)
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    opened = len(nodes.clients)

    await runtime.enable(ble)

    await wait_until(lambda: sources(ble) == [lent("kitchen")], message="the node to be lent to it")
    assert runtime.status(esphome).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING
    assert len(nodes.clients) == opened, "ESPHome kept its node connections"


async def test_a_border_router_coming_later_is_taken_in_place(
    runtime: Runtime, esphome: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, nodes: Nodes
):
    await pair(esphome, mdns, "kitchen")
    opened = len(nodes.clients)

    await runtime.add(FakePeripheral("otbr", provides=[Endpoint("thread", "otbr-rest", "http://otbr:8081")]))

    await wait_until(lambda: "thread" in esphome.peripherals.bound, message="the border router to be handed over")
    assert runtime.status(esphome).state == PeripheralState.RUNNING
    assert len(nodes.clients) == opened, "ESPHome kept its node connections"


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_catalogue.py
================================================================================
"""The entity catalogue: every kind ESPHome's API knows is mapped, hosted by a virtual node, or explained.

Two layers, as in the Matter integration:

- fast checks over the installed `aioesphomeapi` (always run): a new kind that is neither mapped nor listed fails
  here, which is the signal to add support (or a recipe, or a reason);
- a sweep over one virtual node per kind (`pytest -m catalogue`, run by the monthly canary): pair it, read its
  states, send a command to every control parameter, and check that nothing breaks.
"""

import asyncio
from typing import Any

import pytest
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.command import DeviceCommand
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterDataType, ParameterRole

from majordom_esphome import generic, mapper
from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice, ESPhomeParameter
from tests.helpers import assert_values_match_parameters, hub_creates_device
from tests.virtual import catalogue
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS
from tests.virtual.runner import VirtualDevice


def test_every_kind_the_library_knows_is_mapped_or_skipped_on_purpose():
    unknown = [
        kind
        for kind in catalogue.all_kinds()
        if kind not in mapper._HAND_WRITTEN and not generic.is_mapped(kind) and kind not in generic.SKIPPED
    ]

    assert unknown == [], (
        f"new entity kinds with no mapping: map {unknown}, or add them to generic.SKIPPED with a reason"
    )


def test_every_kind_the_library_knows_has_a_recipe_or_a_reason():
    recipe_kinds = {catalogue.kind_of(key) for key in catalogue.RECIPES}
    unexplained = [k for k in catalogue.all_kinds() if k not in recipe_kinds and k not in catalogue.UNHOSTABLE]

    assert unexplained == [], (
        f"new entity kinds {unexplained}: write a recipe in catalogue.RECIPES (switch on every capability of the "
        "entity, so every field it exposes is tested), with its EXPECTED parameters and UNMAPPED fields, or explain in "
        "catalogue.UNHOSTABLE why the host node cannot run it"
    )


def test_the_catalogue_tables_agree():
    kinds = set(catalogue.all_kinds())
    named = {catalogue.kind_of(key) for key in (*catalogue.RECIPES, *catalogue.EXPECTED, *catalogue.UNMAPPED)}
    named |= set(catalogue.UNHOSTABLE)

    assert named - kinds == set(), f"kinds the library no longer knows: {sorted(named - kinds)}"
    assert {catalogue.kind_of(key) for key in catalogue.RECIPES} & set(catalogue.UNHOSTABLE) == set()
    assert set(catalogue.EXPECTED) == set(catalogue.RECIPES), "every recipe needs its EXPECTED parameters, and back"
    assert set(catalogue.UNMAPPED) <= set(catalogue.RECIPES)


def sample_value(parameter: ESPhomeParameter) -> Any:
    """A value the parameter accepts, picked from what the parameter itself declares."""
    if parameter.fields:  # a struct, or a command with arguments: a value per sub-parameter, keyed by its id
        subs = [ESPhomeParameter.model_validate(sub) for sub in parameter.fields]
        return {str(sub.id): sample_value(sub) for sub in subs}
    low, high = parameter.min_value, parameter.max_value
    match parameter.data_type:
        case ParameterDataType.bool:
            return True
        case ParameterDataType.none:
            return None
        case ParameterDataType.enum:
            return next(iter(parameter.valid_values or {0: ""}))
        case ParameterDataType.integer:
            return int(low) if low is not None else 1
        case ParameterDataType.decimal:
            return (low + high) / 2 if low is not None and high is not None else 1.0
        case _:
            return "x"


@pytest.mark.catalogue
@pytest.mark.timeout(120)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("recipe", catalogue.recipe_keys())
async def test_every_entity_kind_works_end_to_end(
    recipe: str, controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, output, build_errors: dict[str, str | None]
):
    kind = catalogue.kind_of(recipe)
    assert build_errors.get(recipe) is None, build_errors.get(recipe)
    sketch = catalogue.sketch_for(recipe)
    node = VirtualDevice(sketch)
    await node.start()
    try:
        await mdns.announce(Advert(name=sketch.name, mac=sketch.mac, port=sketch.port))
        (discovery,) = controller.discoveries.values()
        await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, discovery)

        await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)

        async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
            device = await repo.get(discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
        assert device is not None
        assert {p.integration_data.component_type for p in device.parameters} <= {kind}
        assert len({p.id for p in device.parameters}) == len(device.parameters)

        # every parameter is the one the recipe's entity must produce ...
        actual = {p.integration_data.sub_field: (p.data_type, p.role) for p in device.parameters}
        assert actual == catalogue.EXPECTED[recipe]

        # ... and every field of the entity's state and command is either exposed or explained
        state, arguments = generic.api_fields(kind)
        sub_fields = {
            ESPhomeParameter.model_validate(sub).integration_data.sub_field
            for p in device.parameters
            for sub in p.fields or []
        }
        unmapped = (state | arguments) - set(actual) - sub_fields  # a date's year is mapped as a field of `date`
        explained = set(catalogue.UNMAPPED.get(recipe, {}))
        assert unmapped == explained, (
            f"{kind}: fields neither mapped nor explained in UNMAPPED: {sorted(unmapped - explained)}; "
            f"explained but now mapped or gone: {sorted(explained - unmapped)}"
        )

        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)  # the node pushes its initial states
        assert_values_match_parameters(output, device)

        for parameter in device.parameters:
            if parameter.role != ParameterRole.control:
                continue
            command = DeviceCommand(device_id=device.id, parameter_id=parameter.id, value=sample_value(parameter))
            await controller.send_command(command, device, parameter)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        await controller.fetch(device)  # raises when the connection was lost
        assert node.running, f"the {kind} node died:\n{node.log[-1500:]}"
        assert_values_match_parameters(output, device)
    finally:
        await node.stop()

# FILE: tests/test_commands.py
================================================================================
"""Hub -> device: commands sent through the controller reach a virtual ESPHome device and take effect."""

from typing import Any

import pytest
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.command import DeviceCommand
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterVisibility
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import param, values, wait_for_value, wait_until
from tests.virtual.runner import VirtualDevice


async def command(controller: ESPhomeController, device: ESPhomeDevice, entity: str, sub_field: str, value: Any):
    target = param(device, entity, sub_field)
    await controller.send_command(
        DeviceCommand(device_id=device.id, parameter_id=target.id, value=value), device, target
    )


async def test_switch_turns_on_and_off(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    relay = param(paired, "Relay")

    await command(controller, paired, "Relay", "state", True)
    await wait_for_value(output, relay, lambda v: v is True)
    await command(controller, paired, "Relay", "state", False)
    await wait_for_value(output, relay, lambda v: v is False)


async def test_fan_turns_on(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "Virtual Fan", "state", True)

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Virtual Fan"), lambda v: v is True)


async def test_light_switches_and_dims(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "Virtual Light", "state", True)
    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Virtual Light"), lambda v: v is True)

    await command(controller, paired, "Virtual Light", "brightness", 0.5)

    await wait_for_value(
        output, param(paired, "Virtual Light", "brightness"), lambda v: v == pytest.approx(0.5, abs=0.02)
    )


async def test_changing_the_hue_keeps_the_saturation(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "RGB Light", "state", True)
    await command(controller, paired, "RGB Light", "color_saturation", 100)
    await wait_for_value(
        output, param(paired, "RGB Light", "color_saturation"), lambda v: v == pytest.approx(100, abs=1)
    )

    await command(controller, paired, "RGB Light", "color_hue", 120)  # green

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "RGB Light", "color_hue"), lambda v: v == pytest.approx(120, abs=2))
    latest = values(output, param(paired, "RGB Light", "color_saturation").id)[-1]
    assert latest == pytest.approx(100, abs=1), "setting the hue must not reset the saturation"


async def test_cover_moves_to_a_position(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "Blinds", "position", 30)

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Blinds", "position"), lambda v: v == pytest.approx(30, abs=1))


async def test_number_is_set(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "Target Temp", "state", 20.5)

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Target Temp"), lambda v: v == 20.5)


async def test_select_is_set_by_option_index(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "Mode", "state", 1)

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Mode"), lambda v: v == 1)


async def test_select_is_set_by_option_name(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "Mode", "state", "MANUAL")

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Mode"), lambda v: v == 1)


async def test_button_is_pressed(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice):
    await command(controller, paired, "Reboot", "state", None)

    await device.wait_log("Reboot pressed")


async def test_climate_mode_and_targets_are_set(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "HVAC", "mode", 3)  # heat
    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "HVAC", "mode"), lambda v: v == 3)

    await command(controller, paired, "HVAC", "target_temperature_low", 19.0)

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "HVAC", "target_temperature_low"), lambda v: v == 19.0)


async def test_climate_mode_is_set_by_name(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await command(controller, paired, "HVAC", "mode", "HEAT")

    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "HVAC", "mode"), lambda v: v == 3)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("entity", "sub_field", "value"),
    [
        ("Temperature", "state", 5.0),  # sensors are read-only
        ("Mode", "state", 7),  # no such option
        ("Mode", "state", "BOOST"),  # no such option name
        ("Mode", "state", True),  # not an option index, although it equals 1
        ("Target Temp", "state", 99.0),  # outside the device's 10..30
        ("Virtual Light", "brightness", 150),  # a percentage
        ("RGB Light", "color_hue", 400),  # degrees
    ],
)
async def test_invalid_commands_are_rejected_before_reaching_the_device(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, entity: str, sub_field: str, value: Any
):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        await command(controller, paired, entity, sub_field, value)


@pytest.mark.timeout(60)
async def test_command_to_an_offline_device_fails_visibly(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await device.stop()
    await wait_until(lambda: paired.id in output.lost_devices, 15, "the device to be reported lost")

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await command(controller, paired, "Relay", "state", True)

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(paired.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    assert stored.last_error


async def test_the_transition_is_a_setting_kept_and_added_to_later_light_commands(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice, output
):
    transition = param(paired, "Virtual Light", "transition_length")
    assert transition.visibility == ParameterVisibility.setting

    await command(controller, paired, "Virtual Light", "transition_length", 1.5)
    await wait_for_value(output, transition, lambda v: v == 1.5)  # echoed, so the Hub stores it
    await command(controller, paired, "Virtual Light", "state", True)

    await device.wait_log("Transition length: 1.5s")
    output.events.clear()
    await controller.fetch(paired)
    await wait_for_value(output, transition, lambda v: v == 1.5)  # kept across fetches


async def test_the_flash_command_takes_its_length_as_an_argument(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice
):
    flash = param(paired, "Virtual Light", "flash")
    (length,) = [type(flash).model_validate(f) for f in flash.fields or []]

    await command(controller, paired, "Virtual Light", "flash", {str(length.id): 1.0})

    await device.wait_log("Flash length: 1.0s")

# FILE: tests/test_controller.py

"""Controller behavior with the device connection mocked: pairing, commands, unpairing, error paths.

Entities are real `aioesphomeapi` descriptions (what a device actually reports), not hand-made mocks.
"""

from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from aioesphomeapi import CameraInfo, LightInfo, SwitchInfo
from majordom_integration_sdk import Endpoint, PeripheralChange, Peripherals, Platform
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.command import DeviceCommand
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Discovery
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterDataType, ParameterRole
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput

import majordom_esphome
from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import assert_not_paired, hub_creates_device, param
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS, settle

SWITCH_KEY = 7  # deliberately different from every other number in the tests


@pytest.fixture
async def mock_discovery(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS) -> Discovery:
    await mdns.announce(Advert())
    (found,) = controller.discoveries.values()
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    return found


@pytest.fixture
async def mock_paired(controller: ESPhomeController, mock_discovery: Discovery, mock_connection: Any, make_entity: Any):
    _, connection = mock_connection
    connection.get_entities.return_value = {
        SWITCH_KEY: make_entity(SwitchInfo, SWITCH_KEY, "Relay"),
        11: make_entity(LightInfo, 11, "Lamp", supported_color_modes=[3]),
    }
    await controller.pair_device(mock_discovery, credentials=None)
    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(mock_discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    return stored


async def test_pairing_stores_a_parameter_per_entity_capability(
    mock_paired: ESPhomeDevice, mock_connection: Any, output: RecordingControllerOutput, controller: ESPhomeController
):
    _, connection = mock_connection

    relay = param(mock_paired, "Relay")
    assert (relay.data_type, relay.role) == (ParameterDataType.bool, ParameterRole.control)
    assert param(mock_paired, "Lamp", "state").data_type == ParameterDataType.bool
    assert param(mock_paired, "Lamp", "brightness").data_type == ParameterDataType.decimal
    assert mock_paired.id in output.connected_devices
    assert mock_paired.id not in controller.discoveries
    connection.start.assert_awaited_once()
    connection.wait_ready.assert_awaited_once()


async def test_pairing_skips_entities_it_cannot_map(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mock_discovery: Discovery, mock_connection: Any, make_entity: Any
):
    _, connection = mock_connection
    connection.get_entities.return_value = {
        1: make_entity(CameraInfo, 1, "Cam"),
        2: make_entity(SwitchInfo, 2, "Relay"),
    }

    await controller.pair_device(mock_discovery, credentials=None)

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(mock_discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    assert {p.integration_data.entity_name for p in stored.parameters} == {"Relay"}


async def test_failed_pairing_is_cleaned_up_and_reported(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    mock_discovery: Discovery,
    mock_connection: Any,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    _, connection = mock_connection
    connection.wait_ready.side_effect = TimeoutError("no answer")

    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
        await controller.pair_device(mock_discovery, credentials=None)

    connection.stop.assert_awaited_once()
    assert mock_discovery.id in controller.discoveries
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, mock_discovery.id)
    assert output.updated_discoveries[-1].last_error, "the user must see why pairing failed"
    assert output.connected_devices == []


async def test_command_reaches_the_connection_with_the_entity_key(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mock_paired: ESPhomeDevice, mock_connection: Any
):
    _, connection = mock_connection
    relay = param(mock_paired, "Relay")

    await controller.send_command(
        DeviceCommand(device_id=mock_paired.id, parameter_id=relay.id, value=True), mock_paired, relay
    )

    connection.send_command.assert_awaited_once_with(SWITCH_KEY, "switch", {"key": SWITCH_KEY, "state": True})


async def test_command_to_disconnected_device_fails_visibly(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mock_paired: ESPhomeDevice, mock_connection: Any
):
    await controller.unpair(mock_paired)
    relay = param(mock_paired, "Relay")

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.send_command(
            DeviceCommand(device_id=mock_paired.id, parameter_id=relay.id, value=True), mock_paired, relay
        )

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(mock_paired.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    assert stored.last_error, "a failed command must leave a user-readable last_error on the device"


async def test_command_on_read_only_parameter_is_rejected(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mock_discovery: Discovery, mock_connection: Any, make_entity: Any
):
    from aioesphomeapi import SensorInfo

    _, connection = mock_connection
    connection.get_entities.return_value = {3: make_entity(SensorInfo, 3, "Temperature")}
    await controller.pair_device(mock_discovery, credentials=None)
    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(mock_discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    temperature = param(stored, "Temperature")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="read-only"):
        await controller.send_command(
            DeviceCommand(device_id=stored.id, parameter_id=temperature.id, value=1.0), stored, temperature
        )

    connection.send_command.assert_not_awaited()


async def test_unpair_closes_the_connection(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mock_paired: ESPhomeDevice, mock_connection: Any
):
    _, connection = mock_connection

    await controller.unpair(mock_paired)

    connection.stop.assert_awaited_once()
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.fetch(mock_paired)


async def test_identify_keeps_the_connection(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mock_paired: ESPhomeDevice, mock_connection: Any
):
    _, connection = mock_connection

    await controller.identify(mock_paired)  # ESPHome has no identify action: nothing to send, nothing may break

    connection.stop.assert_not_awaited()
    await controller.fetch(mock_paired)


async def test_fetch_of_unknown_device_raises(controller: ESPhomeController, mock_paired: ESPhomeDevice):
    stranger = mock_paired.model_copy(update={"id": UUID(int=1)})

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.fetch(stranger)


def test_it_needs_zeroconf_and_borrows_the_router_never_raw_bluetooth():
    needs = {need.family: need for need in ESPhomeController.needs}
    assert needs["mdns"].dialects == ["zeroconf"] and needs["mdns"].is_required
    assert needs["ble"].accepts(Endpoint("ble", "router")) and not needs["ble"].is_required
    assert not needs["ble"].accepts(Endpoint("ble", "bluez", "hci0"))


def test_the_package_provides_its_controller_alone(platform: Platform):
    (controller,) = majordom_esphome.peripherals(platform)

    assert isinstance(controller, ESPhomeController) and controller.platform is platform
    assert (controller.name, controller.key) == ("ESPHome", "esphome")


async def test_a_border_router_coming_and_going_needs_no_restart(controller: ESPhomeController):
    border_router = Endpoint("thread", "otbr-rest", "http://otbr:8081")

    assert await controller.needed_peripheral_did_change(PeripheralChange("thread", None, border_router))
    assert await controller.needed_peripheral_did_change(PeripheralChange("thread", border_router, None))


async def test_another_zeroconf_restarts_it(controller: ESPhomeController):
    zeroconf = controller.peripherals.endpoint("mdns")
    moved = PeripheralChange("mdns", zeroconf, Endpoint("mdns", "zeroconf", "other", instance=zeroconf.instance))

    assert not await controller.needed_peripheral_did_change(moved)


async def test_a_start_cut_short_stops_cleanly_and_starts_again(
    platform: Platform,
    peripherals: Peripherals,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
):
    controller = ESPhomeController(platform)
    controller.peripherals, controller.output = peripherals, output
    monkeypatch.setattr(ESPhomeController, "_load_paired_devices", AsyncMock(side_effect=RuntimeError("no database")))
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        await controller.start()

    await controller.stop()  # as the runtime does after a failed start, keeping the instance
    await settle()
    assert [browser for browser in mdns.browsers if not browser.cancelled] == []
    monkeypatch.undo()

    await controller.start()
    try:
        await mdns.announce(Advert())
        assert len(controller.discoveries) == 1
    finally:
        await controller.stop()


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_discovery.py
================================================================================
"""mDNS discovery: nodes announced through the SDK's zeroconf service become correct discoveries."""

import pytest
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas import CredentialsType
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS, settle

MAC = "983569abf679"


async def test_announced_node_becomes_a_discovery(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await mdns.announce(Advert())

    assert len(output.received_discoveries) == 1
    discovered = output.received_discoveries[0]
    assert controller.discoveries == {discovered.id: discovered}
    assert discovered.integration == controller.key  # the Hub creates its device in the controller's scope


async def test_controller_stops_listening_on_stop(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await controller.stop()
    await settle()  # the SDK cancels the browser in a task

    await mdns.announce(Advert())

    assert controller.discoveries == {}


async def test_discovery_id_is_the_sdk_hardware_identity(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await mdns.announce(Advert(mac=MAC))

    assert list(controller.discoveries) == [controller.device_uuid(MAC)]


async def test_discovery_is_named_after_the_node_not_its_mdns_record(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await mdns.announce(Advert(name="kitchen_relay"))

    assert next(iter(controller.discoveries.values())).device_name == "kitchen_relay"


async def test_friendly_name_is_preferred_when_the_node_has_one(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await mdns.announce(Advert(name="kitchen_relay", friendly_name="Kitchen Relay"))

    assert next(iter(controller.discoveries.values())).device_name == "Kitchen Relay"


async def test_discovery_does_not_claim_a_device_category(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await mdns.announce(Advert())

    assert next(iter(controller.discoveries.values())).device_category is None  # a node may host anything


async def test_plain_node_needs_no_credentials(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await mdns.announce(Advert(encrypted=False))

    assert next(iter(controller.discoveries.values())).expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.none]


async def test_encrypted_node_asks_for_its_key(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    await mdns.announce(Advert(encrypted=True))

    assert next(iter(controller.discoveries.values())).expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.secret]


async def test_repeated_announcement_is_not_a_new_discovery(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await mdns.announce(Advert())
    await mdns.announce(Advert())

    assert len(output.received_discoveries) == 1
    assert output.updated_discoveries == []


async def test_changed_announcement_updates_the_discovery(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await mdns.announce(Advert(encrypted=False))

    await mdns.announce(Advert(encrypted=True))

    assert len(output.updated_discoveries) == 1
    assert output.updated_discoveries[0].expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.secret]
    assert list(controller.discoveries.values()) == output.updated_discoveries


async def test_vanished_node_is_lost(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, output: RecordingControllerOutput):
    advert = Advert()
    await mdns.announce(advert)
    (discovery_id,) = controller.discoveries

    await mdns.goodbye(advert)

    assert output.lost_discoveries == [discovery_id]
    assert controller.discoveries == {}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "incomplete", [Advert(mac=None), Advert(server=None, addresses=[])], ids=["no-mac", "no-address"]
)
async def test_incomplete_announcement_never_raises(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, output: RecordingControllerOutput, incomplete: Advert
):
    await mdns.announce(incomplete)  # must not break the SDK's discovery loop

    assert output.error_log == []


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_encryption.py
================================================================================
"""Devices with Noise API encryption: the key is requested, validated, used, kept and never leaked."""

import logging

import pytest
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas import CredentialsType, ProvidedCredentials
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Discovery
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import assert_not_paired, hub_creates_device, leaked_tasks, param, wait_for_value, wait_until
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS
from tests.virtual.runner import ENCRYPTION_KEY as KEY
from tests.virtual.runner import VirtualDevice

WRONG_KEY = "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA="


@pytest.fixture
async def encrypted_discovery(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, encrypted_device: VirtualDevice
) -> Discovery:
    await mdns.announce(Advert(name="test_node_enc", port=encrypted_device.port, encrypted=True))
    (found,) = controller.discoveries.values()
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    return found


def secret(value: str | None) -> ProvidedCredentials:
    return ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.secret, value=value)


async def test_discovery_asks_for_the_key(encrypted_discovery: Discovery):
    assert encrypted_discovery.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.secret]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("credentials", [None, ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.none)])
async def test_pairing_without_the_key_is_refused(
    controller: ESPhomeController, encrypted_discovery: Discovery, credentials: ProvidedCredentials | None
):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        await controller.pair_device(encrypted_discovery, credentials)

    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, encrypted_discovery.id)


async def test_pairing_with_a_code_instead_of_the_key_is_refused(
    controller: ESPhomeController, encrypted_discovery: Discovery
):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        await controller.pair_device(encrypted_discovery, ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.code, value=KEY))


@pytest.mark.timeout(60)
async def test_pairing_with_a_wrong_key_fails_cleanly(
    controller: ESPhomeController, encrypted_discovery: Discovery, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    with pytest.raises((ConnectionError, TimeoutError, ValueError)):
        await controller.pair_device(encrypted_discovery, secret(WRONG_KEY))

    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, encrypted_discovery.id)
    assert output.connected_devices == []
    assert "key" in (output.updated_discoveries[-1].last_error or "").lower(), (
        "the user must be told the key was rejected"
    )
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_pairing_with_the_key_works_like_a_plain_device(
    controller: ESPhomeController, encrypted_discovery: Discovery, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await controller.pair_device(encrypted_discovery, secret(KEY))

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(encrypted_discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    assert len(stored.parameters) == 33
    assert stored.integration_data.encryption_key == KEY
    await wait_for_value(output, param(stored, "Temperature"), lambda v: v == 21.5)


@pytest.mark.timeout(60)
async def test_encrypted_device_reconnects_after_hub_restart(
    controller: ESPhomeController, encrypted_discovery: Discovery, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await controller.pair_device(encrypted_discovery, secret(KEY))
    await controller.stop()
    output.connected_devices.clear()
    restarted = ESPhomeController(controller.platform)
    restarted.peripherals = controller.peripherals
    restarted.output = controller.output

    await restarted.start()
    try:
        await wait_until(
            lambda: encrypted_discovery.id in output.connected_devices, 15, "the encrypted device to reconnect"
        )
    finally:
        await restarted.stop()


async def test_the_key_is_never_logged(
    controller: ESPhomeController, encrypted_discovery: Discovery, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
):
    caplog.set_level(logging.DEBUG)

    await controller.pair_device(encrypted_discovery, secret(KEY))
    with pytest.raises((ConnectionError, TimeoutError, ValueError)):
        await controller.pair_device(encrypted_discovery, secret(WRONG_KEY))

    assert KEY not in caplog.text
    assert WRONG_KEY not in caplog.text


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_enum_commands.py
================================================================================
"""Enum parameters (a select, option lists, the library's integer enums): the value the Hub sends and the one reported.

An enum's value is the integer key of `valid_values`, its label the option or member name. The Hub may send either: the
key (also as a numeric string, as JSON may carry it) or the label. Both must reach the device as the same command, and
the device's state must come back as the key.
"""

from typing import Any

import pytest
from aioesphomeapi import (
    ClimateFanMode,
    ClimateInfo,
    ClimateMode,
    EntityInfo,
    FanInfo,
    LightInfo,
    SelectInfo,
    SelectState,
)

from majordom_esphome import mapper
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeParameter
from tests.test_unhosted_fields import parameter_of, spec_of

# the library's dataclasses are not typed for construction
Select: Any = SelectInfo
Climate: Any = ClimateInfo
Fan: Any = FanInfo
Light: Any = LightInfo
Selected: Any = SelectState

MODE = Select(object_id="mode", key=9, name="Mode", options=["Eco", "Comfort", "Boost"])
THERMOSTAT = Climate(
    object_id="hvac",
    key=7,
    name="HVAC",
    supported_modes=[ClimateMode.OFF, ClimateMode.HEAT],
    supported_fan_modes=[ClimateFanMode.LOW, ClimateFanMode.HIGH],
    supported_custom_fan_modes=["Breeze", "Gust"],
)
FAN = Fan(object_id="fan", key=5, name="Fan", supported_preset_modes=["eco", "turbo"])
LIGHT = Light(object_id="light", key=3, name="Light", supported_color_modes=[1], effects=["None", "Rainbow"])


def parameter(entity: EntityInfo, sub_field: str) -> ESPhomeParameter:
    spec = spec_of(entity, sub_field)
    assert spec is not None
    return parameter_of(entity, spec)


def stored(parameter: ESPhomeParameter) -> ESPhomeParameter:
    """The parameter as it comes back from storage: JSON object keys are strings."""
    return ESPhomeParameter.model_validate_json(parameter.model_dump_json())


# (entity, sub_field, key, label, the argument the library's command gets)
CASES = [
    pytest.param(MODE, "state", 2, "Boost", "Boost", id="select"),
    pytest.param(THERMOSTAT, "mode", int(ClimateMode.HEAT), "HEAT", ClimateMode.HEAT, id="climate mode"),
    pytest.param(THERMOSTAT, "fan_mode", int(ClimateFanMode.HIGH), "HIGH", ClimateFanMode.HIGH, id="climate fan mode"),
    pytest.param(THERMOSTAT, "custom_fan_mode", 1, "Gust", "Gust", id="climate custom fan mode"),
    pytest.param(FAN, "preset_mode", 1, "turbo", "turbo", id="fan preset"),
    pytest.param(LIGHT, "effect", 1, "Rainbow", "Rainbow", id="light effect"),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("entity", "sub_field", "key", "label", "sent"), CASES)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("given", ["key", "numeric string", "label"])
def test_an_enum_is_set_by_its_key_or_its_label(
    entity: EntityInfo, sub_field: str, key: int, label: str, sent: Any, given: str
):
    value = {"key": key, "numeric string": str(key), "label": label}[given]

    for target in (parameter(entity, sub_field), stored(parameter(entity, sub_field))):
        args = mapper.build_command_args(target, value, {})
        assert args == {"key": entity.key, sub_field: sent}
        assert type(args[sub_field]) is type(sent)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("entity", "sub_field", "key", "label", "sent"), CASES)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [99, "99", "no such option", True, None, 1.5])
def test_an_enum_value_that_names_no_option_is_rejected(
    entity: EntityInfo, sub_field: str, key: int, label: str, sent: Any, value: Any
):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        mapper.build_command_args(parameter(entity, sub_field), value, {})


def test_a_select_state_is_reported_as_the_key_of_its_option():
    assert mapper.state_values(MODE, Selected(key=9, state="Boost")) == {"state": 2}
    assert mapper.state_values(MODE, Selected(key=9, state="Eco")) == {"state": 0}
    assert mapper.state_values(MODE, Selected(key=9, state="Unknown")) == {}  # not an option: nothing to report


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_fallback.py
================================================================================
"""Entities without a hand-written mapping (lock, valve, text, ...) are mapped generically from the library's types.

The virtual node `extras.yaml` hosts them. What has no meaningful mapping (events, multi-argument commands) is skipped
without breaking pairing.
"""

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from typing import Any

import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.command import DeviceCommand
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterDataType as T
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterRole as R
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import ParameterUnit, ParameterVisibility

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import assert_values_match_parameters, hub_creates_device, param, wait_for_value
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS
from tests.virtual.runner import EXTRAS, VirtualDevice

pytestmark = pytest.mark.timeout(60)


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def extras_device() -> AsyncIterator[VirtualDevice]:
    virtual = VirtualDevice(EXTRAS)
    await virtual.start()
    yield virtual
    await virtual.stop()


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def extras(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, extras_device: VirtualDevice) -> ESPhomeDevice:
    await mdns.announce(Advert(name=EXTRAS.name, mac=EXTRAS.mac, port=EXTRAS.port))
    (discovery,) = controller.discoveries.values()
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, discovery)
    await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)
