    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    return stored


async def send(controller: ESPhomeController, device: ESPhomeDevice, entity: str, sub_field: str, value):
    target = param(device, entity, sub_field)
    await controller.send_command(
        DeviceCommand(device_id=device.id, parameter_id=target.id, value=value), device, target
    )


async def test_unmapped_entities_get_parameters_from_the_library_types(extras: ESPhomeDevice):
    actual = {
        (p.integration_data.entity_name, p.integration_data.sub_field): (p.data_type, p.role) for p in extras.parameters
    }

    assert actual == {
        ("Door", "state"): (T.enum, R.sensor),
        ("Door", "command"): (T.enum, R.control),
        ("Garden Valve", "position"): (T.decimal, R.control),
        ("Garden Valve", "current_operation"): (T.enum, R.sensor),
        ("Garden Valve", "stop"): (T.none, R.control),  # a flag that only means "do it": a button
        ("Label", "state"): (T.string, R.control),
        ("House Alarm", "state"): (T.enum, R.sensor),
        ("House Alarm", "command"): (T.enum, R.control),
        ("House Alarm", "command_with_code"): (T.struct, R.control),  # the panel requires a code
        ("House Alarm", "code"): (T.string, R.control),  # its default code, a setting
        ("Date", "date"): (T.struct, R.control),  # year, month and day as its fields
    }  # the doorbell (an event) is skipped


async def test_enums_are_integers_labelled_with_the_library_enum_names(extras: ESPhomeDevice):
    assert param(extras, "Door", "command").valid_values == {0: "UNLOCK", 1: "LOCK", 2: "OPEN"}
    assert param(extras, "Door", "state").valid_values == {
        0: "NONE",
        1: "LOCKED",
        2: "UNLOCKED",
        3: "JAMMED",
        4: "LOCKING",
        5: "UNLOCKING",
        6: "OPENING",
        7: "OPEN",
    }
    assert param(extras, "Garden Valve", "current_operation").valid_values == {
        0: "IDLE",
        1: "IS_OPENING",
        2: "IS_CLOSING",
    }


async def test_fractions_are_percentages_like_in_the_hand_written_mapping(extras: ESPhomeDevice):
    position = param(extras, "Garden Valve", "position")

    assert (position.unit, position.min_value, position.max_value) == (ParameterUnit.percentage, 0, 100)


async def test_states_are_reported_with_the_declared_types(extras: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await wait_for_value(output, param(extras, "Door", "state"))
    await wait_for_value(output, param(extras, "Garden Valve", "position"), lambda v: v == 100)

    assert_values_match_parameters(output, extras)


async def test_text_is_set(controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await send(controller, extras, "Label", "state", "hello")

    await wait_for_value(output, param(extras, "Label"), lambda v: v == "hello")


async def test_lock_is_locked_by_an_enum_command(controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await send(controller, extras, "Door", "command", 1)  # LOCK

    await wait_for_value(output, param(extras, "Door", "state"), lambda v: v == 1)  # LOCKED


async def test_valve_moves_to_a_position_in_percent(controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    await send(controller, extras, "Garden Valve", "position", 40)

    await wait_for_value(output, param(extras, "Garden Valve", "position"), lambda v: v == pytest.approx(40, abs=1))


async def test_a_flag_command_is_a_button(
    controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, extras_device: VirtualDevice
):
    await send(controller, extras, "Garden Valve", "stop", None)

    await extras_device.wait_log("Valve stop")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("entity", "sub_field", "value"), [("Door", "state", 1), ("Door", "command", 9)])
async def test_invalid_generic_commands_are_rejected(
    controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, entity: str, sub_field: str, value: int
):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        await send(controller, extras, entity, sub_field, value)


def subs(parameter) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Sub-parameters by name."""
    return {
        sub.integration_data.sub_field: sub for sub in (type(parameter).model_validate(f) for f in parameter.fields)
    }


async def test_a_date_is_one_struct_value_set_and_reported_by_its_fields(
    controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, output
):
    date = param(extras, "Date", "date")
    fields = subs(date)
    value = {str(fields["year"].id): 2026, str(fields["month"].id): 10, str(fields["day"].id): 2}

    await send(controller, extras, "Date", "date", value)

    await wait_for_value(output, date, lambda v: v == value)
    assert (fields["month"].min_value, fields["month"].max_value) == (1, 12)


async def test_a_command_that_needs_a_code_takes_it_as_an_argument(
    controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, output
):
    command = param(extras, "House Alarm", "command_with_code")
    fields = subs(command)

    await send(
        controller,
        extras,
        "House Alarm",
        "command_with_code",
        {
            str(fields["command"].id): 1,  # ARM_AWAY
            str(fields["code"].id): "1234",
        },
    )

    await wait_for_value(output, param(extras, "House Alarm", "state"), lambda v: v != 0)  # no longer DISARMED


async def test_a_kept_default_code_lets_a_plain_command_through(
    controller: ESPhomeController, extras: ESPhomeDevice, output
):
    code, state = param(extras, "House Alarm", "code"), param(extras, "House Alarm", "state")
    assert code.visibility == ParameterVisibility.setting
    await send(controller, extras, "House Alarm", "command", 1)  # ARM_AWAY: arming needs no code on this panel
    await wait_for_value(output, state, lambda v: v == 2, timeout=10)  # ARMED_AWAY after its arming time

    await send(controller, extras, "House Alarm", "code", "1234")
    await wait_for_value(output, code, lambda v: v == "1234")  # echoed, so the Hub stores it
    await send(controller, extras, "House Alarm", "command", 0)  # DISARM, typed without a code: it needs one

    await wait_for_value(output, state, lambda v: v == 0, timeout=10)  # DISARMED: the kept code was sent


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_improv.py
================================================================================
"""Unprovisioned nodes over Improv BLE: found by their advert, given the Hub's Wi-Fi, then paired over the network.

ESPHome host nodes have no BLE, so the node's Improv GATT service is scripted below as the connection a Bluetooth source
hands out; the SDK's real Bluetooth router routes its adverts and connections. Once the node "joins" Wi-Fi, the compiled
keyless virtual node appears over mDNS.
"""

import asyncio
import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import replace

import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
from bleak.backends.device import BLEDevice
from bleak.backends.scanner import AdvertisementData
from improv_ble_client import SERVICE_DATA_UUID, SERVICE_UUID, Error, State
from improv_ble_client.protocol import (
    CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_CAPABILITIES,
    CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_ERROR,
    CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_RPC_COMMAND,
    CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_RPC_RESULT,
    CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_STATE,
    IMPROV_CHARACTERISTICS,
    WiFiSettingsCmd,
    WiFiSettingsRes,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk import MissingCredentialsError, Platform, WifiCredentials
from majordom_integration_sdk.capabilities import BLE_ROUTER, BLEDiscoveryInfo, GattCharacteristic, GattService
from majordom_integration_sdk.peripherals import PeripheralChange, Peripherals
from majordom_integration_sdk.runtime.peripherals.providers.ble.router import BLEService
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas import CredentialsType
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Discovery
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import FakeBLESource, RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome import controller as controller_module
from majordom_esphome import improv
from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import (
    assert_not_paired,
    hub_creates_device,
    leaked_tasks,
    wait_until,
)
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS
from tests.virtual.runner import KEYLESS, VirtualDevice

pytestmark = pytest.mark.timeout(60)


def router_of(controller: ESPhomeController) -> BLEService:
    router = controller.peripherals.instance(BLE_ROUTER)
    assert isinstance(router, BLEService)
    return router


HOME = WifiCredentials("Home", "correct horse battery")
HANDLES = {uuid: 0x11 + i for i, uuid in enumerate(IMPROV_CHARACTERISTICS)}


class FakeImprovNode:
    """An unprovisioned ESPHome node's Improv GATT service, as the `BLEConnection` a Bluetooth source hands out."""

    def __init__(self, name: str = KEYLESS.name, address: str = "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01"):
        self.name, self.address = name, address
        self.state = State.AUTHORIZED
        self.password = HOME.password  # of the network it can join
        self.fails_with: Error | None = None
        self.received: list[WifiCredentials] = []
        self.on_joined: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]] | None = None  # it shows up on the network
        self._callbacks: dict[int, Callable[[bytes], None]] = {}

    def advertisement(self, named: bool = True) -> AdvertisementData:
        return AdvertisementData(
            local_name=self.name if named else None,
            manufacturer_data={},
            service_data={SERVICE_DATA_UUID: self._service_data()},
            service_uuids=[SERVICE_UUID],
            tx_power=None,
            rssi=-60,
            platform_data=(),
        )

    def info(self, named: bool = True) -> BLEDiscoveryInfo:
        return BLEDiscoveryInfo(BLEDevice(self.address, None, None), self.advertisement(named))

    async def advertise(self, source: FakeBLESource, named: bool = True, rssi: int = -60):
        """Heard by ``source``; returns once the SDK has passed the advert on."""
        name = self.name if named else None
        source.advertise(self.address, rssi, name, [SERVICE_UUID], {SERVICE_DATA_UUID: self._service_data()})
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

    async def press_button(self):
        self.state = State.AUTHORIZED
        self._notify(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_STATE, self.state)

    def _service_data(self) -> bytes:
        return bytes([self.state, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])

    # BLEConnection

    @property
    def mtu(self) -> int:
        return 247

    async def services(self) -> list[GattService]:
        characteristics = tuple(GattCharacteristic(uuid, handle, ("read",)) for uuid, handle in HANDLES.items())
        return [GattService(SERVICE_UUID, 0x10, characteristics)]

    async def read(self, handle: int) -> bytes:
        values = {HANDLES[CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_STATE]: self.state, HANDLES[CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_CAPABILITIES]: 0}
        return bytes([values.get(handle, Error.NO_ERROR)])

    async def write(self, handle: int, data: bytes, is_response_needed: bool = True):
        assert handle == HANDLES[CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_RPC_COMMAND]
        command = WiFiSettingsCmd.from_bytes(data)
        asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(
            self._join(WifiCredentials(command.ssid.decode(), command.password.decode()))
        )

    async def start_notify(self, handle: int, callback: Callable[[bytes], None]):
        self._callbacks[handle] = callback

    async def stop_notify(self, handle: int):
        self._callbacks.pop(handle, None)

    async def disconnect(self):
        self._callbacks.clear()

    async def _join(self, wifi: WifiCredentials):
        if self.state == State.AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED:
            self._notify(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_ERROR, Error.NOT_AUTHORIZED)
            return
        self.received.append(wifi)
        self._notify(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_ERROR, Error.NO_ERROR)
        self._notify(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_STATE, State.PROVISIONING)
        error = self.fails_with or (Error.UNABLE_TO_CONNECT if wifi.password != self.password else None)
        if error is not None:
            self._notify(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_ERROR, error)
            self._notify(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_STATE, State.AUTHORIZED)
            return
        self.state = State.PROVISIONED
        self._notify(CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_STATE, self.state)
        if callback := self._callbacks.get(HANDLES[CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_RPC_RESULT]):
            callback(WiFiSettingsRes(b"http://127.0.0.1", []).as_bytes())
        if self.on_joined is not None:
            await self.on_joined()

    def _notify(self, uuid: str, value: int):
        if callback := self._callbacks.get(HANDLES[uuid]):
            callback(bytes([value]))


@pytest.fixture
def node(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> FakeImprovNode:
    monkeypatch.setattr(improv, "AUTHORIZATION_TIMEOUT", 1.0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(improv, "LEASE_TIMEOUT", 0.5)
    monkeypatch.setattr(controller_module, "NODE_APPEAR_TIMEOUT", 1.0)
    return FakeImprovNode()


@pytest.fixture
def radio(node: FakeImprovNode) -> FakeBLESource:
    """The Hub's own Bluetooth adapter."""
    return FakeBLESource("hci0", connection=node)


@pytest.fixture
def platform(platform: Platform) -> Platform:
    return replace(platform, wifi=HOME)


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def router(radio: FakeBLESource) -> AsyncIterator[BLEService]:
    ble = BLEService(sources=[radio])
    await ble.start()
    yield ble
    await ble.stop()


@pytest.fixture
def peripherals(peripherals: Peripherals, router: BLEService) -> Peripherals:
    return Peripherals({**peripherals.bound, "ble": router.endpoint})


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def ble_discovery(controller: ESPhomeController, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource) -> Discovery:
    await node.advertise(radio)
    (found,) = controller.discoveries.values()
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    return found


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def keyless_device() -> AsyncIterator[VirtualDevice]:
    virtual = VirtualDevice(KEYLESS)
    await virtual.start()
    yield virtual
    await virtual.stop()


def joins_as_keyless_device(node: FakeImprovNode, mdns: FakeMDNS):
    async def appear():
        await mdns.announce(Advert(name=KEYLESS.name, mac=KEYLESS.mac, port=KEYLESS.port, keyless=True))

    node.on_joined = appear


async def last_error(output: RecordingControllerOutput, discovery: Discovery) -> str:
    return next((d.last_error or "" for d in reversed(output.updated_discoveries) if d.id == discovery.id), "")


# Discovery


async def test_a_node_waiting_for_wifi_is_discovered_by_its_name(
    controller: ESPhomeController, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await node.advertise(radio)

    (discovery,) = output.received_discoveries
    assert discovery.id == controller.device_uuid(f"improv:{node.name}")
    assert (discovery.transport, discovery.device_name) == ("ble", node.name)
    assert discovery.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.none], "the Hub gives it its own Wi-Fi"


async def test_the_discovery_id_follows_the_name_not_the_ble_address(
    controller: ESPhomeController, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource
):
    await node.advertise(radio)
    first = set(controller.discoveries)
    await controller.ble_did_remove_device(router_of(controller), node.info())
    node.address = "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:02"  # a random (resolvable private) address changes

    await node.advertise(radio)

    assert set(controller.discoveries) == first


async def test_the_name_is_remembered_for_the_adverts_that_do_not_carry_it(
    controller: ESPhomeController, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await node.advertise(radio, named=False)
    assert controller.discoveries == {}, "without its name the node has no stable identity yet"

    await node.advertise(radio)
    node.state = State.AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
    await node.advertise(radio, named=False)

    assert len(output.received_discoveries) == 1
    assert list(controller.discoveries) == [output.received_discoveries[0].id]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("state", [State.PROVISIONING, State.PROVISIONED])
async def test_a_node_that_already_has_wifi_is_not_offered(
    controller: ESPhomeController, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource, state: State
):
    node.state = state

    await node.advertise(radio)

    assert controller.discoveries == {}


async def test_a_node_that_stops_advertising_is_lost(
    controller: ESPhomeController, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await node.advertise(radio)

    await controller.ble_did_remove_device(router_of(controller), node.info(named=False))

    assert controller.discoveries == {}
    assert output.lost_discoveries == [output.received_discoveries[0].id]


async def test_ble_discovery_stops_with_the_controller(
    controller: ESPhomeController, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource
):
    await controller.stop()

    await node.advertise(radio)

    assert controller.discoveries == {}


async def test_a_router_handed_over_once_it_runs_is_listened_to_without_a_restart(
    platform: Platform, peripherals: Peripherals, router: BLEService, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource
):
    controller = ESPhomeController(platform)
    controller.peripherals = Peripherals({"mdns": peripherals.endpoint("mdns")})
    await controller.start()
    try:
        controller.peripherals = peripherals
        assert await controller.needed_peripheral_did_change(PeripheralChange("ble", None, router.endpoint))

        await node.advertise(radio)

        assert len(controller.discoveries) == 1
    finally:
        await controller.stop()


async def test_a_lost_router_is_let_go_without_a_restart(
    controller: ESPhomeController, router: BLEService, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource
):
    controller.peripherals = Peripherals({"mdns": controller.peripherals.endpoint("mdns")})
    assert await controller.needed_peripheral_did_change(PeripheralChange("ble", router.endpoint, None))

    await node.advertise(radio)

    assert controller.discoveries == {}


async def test_the_nodes_heard_through_a_lost_router_are_lost_with_it(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    router: BLEService,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    radio: FakeBLESource,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    await node.advertise(radio)

    controller.peripherals = Peripherals({"mdns": controller.peripherals.endpoint("mdns")})
    assert await controller.needed_peripheral_did_change(PeripheralChange("ble", router.endpoint, None))

    assert controller.discoveries == {}, "nothing can set them up without a router"
    assert output.lost_discoveries == [output.received_discoveries[0].id]


# Pairing: Wi-Fi over BLE, then the node over the network


async def test_pairing_gives_the_node_the_hubs_wifi_then_pairs_it_with_a_key_of_its_own(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    keyless_device: VirtualDevice,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    joins_as_keyless_device(node, mdns)

    device_id = await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert node.received == [HOME]
    assert device_id is not None
    assert device_id == controller.device_uuid(KEYLESS.mac), "the device takes the node's own identity"
    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        device = await repo.get(device_id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
        assert await repo.get(ble_discovery.id) is None, "the Hub's device moved to the node's identity"
    assert device is not None
    assert device.name == "Kitchen relay", "what the user chose is kept"
    assert device.integration_data.encryption_key and device.parameters
    assert (device.available, device.last_error) == (True, None)
    assert output.connected_devices == [device_id]
    assert controller.discoveries == {}
    assert device_id in output.lost_discoveries, "the node's mDNS discovery was paired through its BLE one"


async def test_a_paired_node_set_up_again_fails_fast_as_already_paired(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    radio: FakeBLESource,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    keyless_device: VirtualDevice,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    """Its Wi-Fi was reset: it waits for Wi-Fi again, joins, and turns out to be a device the Hub has."""
    joins_as_keyless_device(node, mdns)
    await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)
    await node.advertise(radio)  # provisioned
    node.state = State.AUTHORIZED  # its Wi-Fi reset: it left the network, and waits for Wi-Fi again
    await mdns.goodbye(Advert(name=KEYLESS.name))
    await node.advertise(radio)
    (again,) = controller.discoveries.values()
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, again, name="Another relay")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="already paired as Kitchen relay"):
        async with asyncio.timeout(controller_module.NODE_APPEAR_TIMEOUT / 2):
            await controller.pair_device(again, credentials=None)

    assert "already paired" in await last_error(output, again)
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, again.id)


async def test_a_node_waiting_for_its_button_tells_the_user_then_carries_on(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    node.state = State.AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None))
    await wait_until(
        lambda: "button" in (controller.discoveries[ble_discovery.id].last_error or ""), 5, "the instruction"
    )

    await node.press_button()

    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):  # the node is given Wi-Fi, but never shows up in this test
        await pairing
    assert node.received == [HOME]


async def unheard_once_given_wifi(router: BLEService, node: FakeImprovNode):
    """Given Wi-Fi, the node stops advertising Improv: the router says it is gone while it is awaited on the network."""
    router._removal_grace_sec = 0.2
    await wait_until(lambda: node.received, message="the node to be given Wi-Fi")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.3)  # the lease ended, nothing heard since
    await router.perform_scan()  # the eviction loop's check
    assert router.devices() == []


async def test_a_node_being_set_up_stays_offered_though_no_radio_hears_it(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    router: BLEService,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None))

    await unheard_once_given_wifi(router, node)

    assert ble_discovery.id in controller.discoveries and output.lost_discoveries == []
    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):  # given Wi-Fi, but it never shows up in this test
        await pairing


async def test_a_failed_setup_loses_a_node_no_radio_hears_any_more(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    router: BLEService,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    """Its removal came while it was set up: none comes again."""
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None))
    await unheard_once_given_wifi(router, node)

    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
        await pairing

    assert ble_discovery.id not in controller.discoveries and output.lost_discoveries == [ble_discovery.id]


async def test_a_button_never_pressed_fails_with_the_instruction(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, node: FakeImprovNode, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    node.state = State.AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED

    with pytest.raises(improv.SetupError):
        await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert node.received == []
    assert "press the button" in (await last_error(output, ble_discovery)).lower()
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, ble_discovery.id)
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("error", "told"),
    [
        (Error.UNABLE_TO_CONNECT, "could not join the wi-fi network home"),
        (Error.NOT_AUTHORIZED, "press the button"),
        (Error.UNKNOWN_ERROR, "could not be set up"),
    ],
)
async def test_an_improv_error_fails_pairing_with_a_clear_reason(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
    error: Error,
    told: str,
):
    node.fails_with = error

    with pytest.raises(improv.SetupError):
        await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert told in (await last_error(output, ble_discovery)).lower()
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, ble_discovery.id)
    assert ble_discovery.id in controller.discoveries, "the user can try again"


async def test_a_wrong_wifi_password_is_reported_and_never_logged(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
    caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture,
):
    caplog.set_level(logging.DEBUG)
    node.password = "another password"

    with pytest.raises(improv.SetupError):
        await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert "wi-fi network home" in (await last_error(output, ble_discovery)).lower()
    assert HOME.password not in caplog.text
    assert HOME.password.encode().hex() not in caplog.text


async def test_a_node_out_of_ble_range_fails_with_a_clear_reason(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, radio: FakeBLESource, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    radio.connection = None

    with pytest.raises(improv.SetupError):
        await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert "bluetooth" in (await last_error(output, ble_discovery)).lower()


async def test_bluetooth_held_by_another_integration_fails_with_a_clear_reason(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, node: FakeImprovNode, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    async with router_of(controller).exclusive(node.address, owner="matter"):
        with pytest.raises(improv.SetupError):
            await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert node.received == []
    assert "busy" in (await last_error(output, ble_discovery)).lower()


async def test_a_node_heard_best_through_another_esphome_node_is_set_up_through_it(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    radio: FakeBLESource,
    mdns: FakeMDNS,
    keyless_device: VirtualDevice,
):
    proxy = FakeBLESource("esphome:a0b1c2d3e4f5", connection=node)
    router = router_of(controller)
    await router.add_source(proxy)
    radio.connection = None  # the Hub's adapter barely hears it: only the ESPHome node can connect
    await node.advertise(radio, rssi=-95)
    await node.advertise(proxy, rssi=-50)
    (discovery,) = controller.discoveries.values()
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, discovery)
    joins_as_keyless_device(node, mdns)

    assert await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None) == controller.device_uuid(KEYLESS.mac)

    assert node.received == [HOME]
    assert (proxy.connected, radio.connected) == ([node.address], [])


async def test_a_node_that_never_shows_up_on_the_network_times_out_with_a_clear_reason(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, node: FakeImprovNode, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
        await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert node.received == [HOME]
    assert "did not show up on the network" in await last_error(output, ble_discovery)
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, ble_discovery.id)
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_hub_without_wifi_cannot_set_up_the_node(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    ble_discovery: Discovery,
    node: FakeImprovNode,
    radio: FakeBLESource,
):
    """A Hub on Ethernet: told apart from any other failure, before the node is touched, so the app can ask for the
    Wi-Fi the node should join (the Hub saves it for the next attempt). The Hub returns the error to the app's pairing
    request, so the discovery's last_error is left as it was."""
    controller.platform = replace(controller.platform, wifi=None)
    radio.connection = None  # any BLE step would fail with another error

    with pytest.raises(MissingCredentialsError) as raised:
        await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    assert raised.value.type == MissingCredentialsError.WIFI
    assert node.received == []
    assert controller.discoveries[ble_discovery.id].last_error is None
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, ble_discovery.id)


async def test_the_reason_stays_on_the_discovery_while_the_node_keeps_advertising(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, node: FakeImprovNode, radio: FakeBLESource
):
    node.fails_with = Error.UNKNOWN_ERROR
    with pytest.raises(improv.SetupError):
        await controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None)

    await node.advertise(radio, named=False)  # a changed advert: the SDK passes it on

    assert controller.discoveries[ble_discovery.id].last_error


# A stop meeting a setup: nothing can hear the node any more, and a run started meanwhile didn't begin it


async def test_a_setup_waiting_for_the_node_on_the_network_ends_with_a_stop(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, node: FakeImprovNode
):
    joined = asyncio.Event()

    async def appear():
        joined.set()  # on Wi-Fi, not announced yet

    node.on_joined = appear
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None))
    await asyncio.wait_for(joined.wait(), 5)

    await controller.stop()

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="stopped"):
        await asyncio.wait_for(pairing, 0.5)  # not after NODE_APPEAR_TIMEOUT
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, ble_discovery.id)
    assert controller._joining == {} and leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_setup_waiting_for_the_button_ends_with_a_stop(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, node: FakeImprovNode, router: BLEService
):
    node.state = State.AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None))
    await wait_until(
        lambda: "button" in (controller.discoveries[ble_discovery.id].last_error or ""), 5, "the instruction"
    )

    await controller.stop()

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError, match="stopped"):
        await asyncio.wait_for(pairing, 0.5)  # not after AUTHORIZATION_TIMEOUT
    assert router._leased == {}, "the node's radio is free again"
    assert node.received == [] and leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_setup_whose_request_went_away_lets_go_of_the_node(
    controller: ESPhomeController, ble_discovery: Discovery, node: FakeImprovNode, router: BLEService
):
    node.state = State.AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
    pairing = asyncio.create_task(controller.pair_device(ble_discovery, credentials=None))
    await wait_until(
        lambda: "button" in (controller.discoveries[ble_discovery.id].last_error or ""), 5, "the instruction"
    )

    pairing.cancel()

    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
        await pairing
    assert router._leased == {} and controller._joining == {}
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("ble_name", "node_name", "same"),
    [
        ("kitchen-relay", "kitchen-relay", True),
        ("kitchen-relay", "kitchen-relay-2", False),
        ("a-very-long-node-nam", "a-very-long-node-name", True),  # cut to 20 characters
        ("a-very-long-n-a1b2c3", "a-very-long-node-name-a1b2c3", True),  # cut, keeping the MAC suffix
        ("a-very-long-node-nam", "a-very-long-node-name-a1b2c3", True),  # cut without keeping the suffix
        ("a-very-long-n-ffffff", "a-very-long-node-name-a1b2c3", False),
    ],
)
def test_a_node_is_recognised_on_the_network_by_the_name_it_advertised(ble_name: str, node_name: str, same: bool):
    assert improv.is_node(ble_name, node_name) == same


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_key_provisioning.py
================================================================================
"""Keyless nodes (`api: encryption:` without a key) are given a key of the integration's own at pairing.

The key is generated, kept, then set over a Noise session with the well-known all-zeros PSK; from then on the node
requires it. The user never types (or sees) a key.
"""

import asyncio
import base64
import json
import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Callable, Coroutine
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import patch
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
from aioesphomeapi import (
    ZERO_NOISE_PSK,
    APIClient,
    APIConnectionError,
    EntityInfo,
    InvalidEncryptionKeyAPIError,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk import Platform
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas import CredentialsType, ProvidedCredentials
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Discovery
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput, build_test_platform

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import assert_not_paired, hub_creates_device, leaked_tasks, param, wait_for_value, wait_until
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS
from tests.virtual.runner import KEYLESS, VirtualDevice

pytestmark = pytest.mark.timeout(60)

NEW_KEY = base64.b64encode(bytes(range(32))).decode()  # set in the YAML of a reflashed node
KEYLESS_ADVERT = Advert(name=KEYLESS.name, mac=KEYLESS.mac, port=KEYLESS.port, keyless=True)


@pytest.fixture
def store() -> dict[UUID, dict[str, Any]]:
    """The Hub's device records: a test deletes one as the Hub does."""
    return {}


@pytest.fixture
def platform(store: dict[UUID, dict[str, Any]], tmp_path: Path) -> Platform:
    return build_test_platform(tmp_path, store=store)


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def keyless_device() -> AsyncIterator[VirtualDevice]:
    virtual = VirtualDevice(KEYLESS)
    await virtual.start()
    yield virtual
    await virtual.stop()


async def discover(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, advert: Advert) -> Discovery:
    await mdns.announce(advert)
    (found,) = controller.discoveries.values()
    return found


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def keyless_discovery(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, keyless_device: VirtualDevice) -> Discovery:
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, KEYLESS_ADVERT)
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    return found


async def stored(controller: ESPhomeController, device_id: Any) -> ESPhomeDevice:
    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        device = await repo.get(device_id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert device is not None
    return device


def assert_is_a_key(key: str | None):
    assert key is not None and key != ZERO_NOISE_PSK
    assert len(base64.b64decode(key, validate=True)) == 32


async def connects(device: VirtualDevice, psk: str | None) -> bool:
    client = APIClient(device.address, device.port, "", noise_psk=psk)
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(5):
            await client.connect(login=True)
    except (APIConnectionError, TimeoutError):
        return False
    finally:
        await client.disconnect()
    return True


# Against the compiled keyless node


async def test_keyless_node_needs_no_credentials(keyless_discovery: Discovery):
    assert keyless_discovery.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.none]


async def test_pairing_gives_the_node_a_key_it_requires_from_then_on(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    keyless_discovery: Discovery,
    keyless_device: VirtualDevice,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    assert await connects(keyless_device, None), "a keyless node accepts plaintext until it has a key"

    await controller.pair_device(keyless_discovery, credentials=None)

    device = await stored(controller, keyless_discovery.id)
    key = device.integration_data.encryption_key
    assert_is_a_key(key)
    assert (device.available, device.last_error) == (True, None)
    await wait_for_value(output, param(device, "Temperature"), lambda v: v == 21.5)
    assert not await connects(keyless_device, None), "plaintext must be refused once the node has its key"
    assert not await connects(keyless_device, ZERO_NOISE_PSK), "the zero PSK must be refused once the node has its key"
    assert await connects(keyless_device, key)


async def test_the_node_keeps_its_key_across_its_restart_and_the_hubs(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    keyless_discovery: Discovery,
    keyless_device: VirtualDevice,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    await controller.pair_device(keyless_discovery, credentials=None)
    await keyless_device.restart()
    await wait_until(lambda: output.connected_devices.count(keyless_discovery.id) == 2, 15, "the node to reconnect")

    await controller.stop()
    output.connected_devices.clear()
    restarted = ESPhomeController(controller.platform)
    restarted.peripherals = controller.peripherals
    restarted.output = controller.output
    await restarted.start()
    try:
        await wait_until(lambda: keyless_discovery.id in output.connected_devices, 15, "the Hub to reconnect")
    finally:
        await restarted.stop()


async def test_the_generated_key_is_never_logged(
    controller: ESPhomeController, keyless_discovery: Discovery, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
):
    caplog.set_level(logging.DEBUG)

    await controller.pair_device(keyless_discovery, credentials=None)

    key = (await stored(controller, keyless_discovery.id)).integration_data.encryption_key
    assert key and key not in caplog.text


async def test_a_node_without_encryption_still_pairs_in_plaintext_with_a_warning(
    controller: ESPhomeController, discovery: Discovery, caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture
):
    caplog.set_level(logging.WARNING)

    await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)

    assert (await stored(controller, discovery.id)).integration_data.encryption_key is None
    warnings = [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if r.levelno == logging.WARNING]
    assert any("api: encryption:" in w for w in warnings), "the node's owner should be told how to encrypt it"


# Failure paths, against a scripted node behind the library's client


@dataclass
class FakeNode:
    """Just enough of a keyless node's native API to be given a key, refuse it, or be unreachable afterwards."""

    accepts_key: bool = True
    reachable_with_key: bool = True
    key: str | None = None
    set_key_sessions: list[str | None] = field(default_factory=list)  # the PSK of every session a key was sent over

    def client(self, address: str, port: int, password: str | None, noise_psk: str | None = None) -> "FakeClient":
        return FakeClient(self, noise_psk)


class FakeClient:
    def __init__(self, node: FakeNode, psk: str | None):
        self.node, self.psk = node, psk
        self.on_stop: Callable[[bool], Coroutine[Any, Any, None]] | None = None

    async def connect(self, login: bool = False, on_stop: Callable[[bool], Coroutine[Any, Any, None]] | None = None):
        self.on_stop = on_stop
        if self.psk != self.node.key and not (self.node.key is None and self.psk == ZERO_NOISE_PSK):
            raise InvalidEncryptionKeyAPIError("handshake failed")
        if self.node.key is not None and not self.node.reachable_with_key:
            raise APIConnectionError("connection refused")

    async def noise_encryption_set_key(self, key: bytes) -> bool:
        self.node.set_key_sessions.append(self.psk)
        if self.node.accepts_key:
            self.node.key = key.decode()
            if self.on_stop is not None:  # like a real node: it drops every session once it uses the new key
                asyncio.get_running_loop().call_later(0.1, asyncio.ensure_future, self.on_stop(False))
        return self.node.accepts_key

    async def list_entities_services(self) -> tuple[list[EntityInfo], list[Any]]:
        return [], []

    def subscribe_states(self, on_state: Callable[..., None]):
        pass

    async def disconnect(self):
        pass


@pytest.fixture
def node() -> Any:
    fake = FakeNode()
    with patch("majordom_esphome.connection.APIClient", fake.client):
        yield fake


async def test_older_firmware_is_given_its_key_in_plaintext_newer_over_the_zero_psk(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode
):
    newer = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, newer)
    await controller.pair_device(newer, credentials=None)
    await controller.unpair(await stored(controller, newer.id))
    node.key = None
    older = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True, zero_psk=False, addresses=["127.0.0.2"]))

    await controller.pair_device(older, credentials=None)

    assert node.set_key_sessions == [ZERO_NOISE_PSK, None]


async def test_a_refused_key_fails_pairing_cleanly(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    node.accepts_key = False
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)

    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)

    assert node.key is None
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, found.id, kept_key=True)
    assert output.connected_devices == []
    assert "key" in (output.updated_discoveries[-1].last_error or "").lower(), "the user must be told why"
    assert found.id in controller.discoveries
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_a_key_set_before_a_failed_reconnect_is_kept_for_the_retry_even_across_a_hub_restart(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    node.reachable_with_key = False
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)
    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, found.id, kept_key=True)
    assert (await stored(controller, found.id)).integration_data.encryption_key == node.key
    assert output.updated_discoveries[-1].last_error
    await controller.stop()
    restarted = ESPhomeController(controller.platform)
    restarted.peripherals = controller.peripherals
    restarted.output = controller.output
    await restarted.start()
    try:
        node.reachable_with_key = True
        # the node now announces a key: most likely ours, so the user need not type one (but may: see below)
        again = await discover(restarted, mdns, Advert(encrypted=True))
        assert again.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.none, CredentialsType.secret]

        await restarted.pair_device(again, credentials=None)

        device = await stored(restarted, found.id)
        assert device.integration_data.encryption_key == node.key
        assert (device.available, device.last_error) == (True, None)
        assert node.set_key_sessions == [ZERO_NOISE_PSK], "the node already has the key: it is not set twice"
        assert restarted.discoveries == {}
    finally:
        await restarted.stop()


async def test_a_key_set_before_a_pairing_the_hub_gave_up_on_is_kept_for_the_retry(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode, store: dict[UUID, dict[str, Any]]
):
    """The Hub deletes its device record when a pairing fails, though the node requires the key from then on."""
    node.reachable_with_key = False
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)
    del store[found.id]
    node.reachable_with_key = True

    again = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(encrypted=True))
    assert again.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.none, CredentialsType.secret]
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, again)
    await controller.pair_device(again, credentials=None)

    assert (await stored(controller, found.id)).integration_data.encryption_key == node.key
    assert node.set_key_sessions == [ZERO_NOISE_PSK], "the node already has the key: it is not set twice"


async def test_a_given_key_is_kept_by_the_nodes_mac_for_the_hub_alone(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode
):
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)

    await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)

    kept = controller.platform.documents_folder(controller) / "keys.json"
    assert json.loads(kept.read_text()) == {"983569abf679": node.key}
    assert kept.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600


async def test_a_given_key_outlasts_a_hard_delete_so_the_node_pairs_again_without_one(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode, store: dict[UUID, dict[str, Any]]
):
    """The Hub unpairs a node, then deletes its record: the node still requires the key, the user never saw it."""
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)
    given = node.key
    await controller.unpair(await stored(controller, found.id))
    del store[found.id]

    again = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(encrypted=True))
    assert again.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.none, CredentialsType.secret]
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, again)
    await controller.pair_device(again, credentials=None)

    assert (await stored(controller, found.id)).integration_data.encryption_key == given
    assert node.set_key_sessions == [ZERO_NOISE_PSK], "the node already has the key: it is not set twice"


async def test_pairing_with_a_key_the_user_typed_forgets_the_given_one(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode
):
    """The node was reflashed with a key of its own: the given one is stale once the typed one is proven, not before."""
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)
    await controller.unpair(await stored(controller, found.id))
    node.key = NEW_KEY
    kept = controller.platform.documents_folder(controller) / "keys.json"

    again = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(encrypted=True))
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.pair_device(again, ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.secret, value=NEW_KEY[::-1]))
    assert json.loads(kept.read_text()) != {}, "a mistyped key proves nothing"
    await controller.pair_device(
        controller.discoveries[again.id], ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.secret, value=NEW_KEY)
    )

    assert json.loads(kept.read_text()) == {}


async def test_a_retry_before_the_node_announces_its_key_does_not_set_it_again(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode
):
    node.reachable_with_key = False
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):
        await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)
    node.reachable_with_key = True

    await controller.pair_device(controller.discoveries[found.id], credentials=None)  # mDNS still says keyless

    assert node.set_key_sessions == [ZERO_NOISE_PSK]
    assert (await stored(controller, found.id)).integration_data.encryption_key == node.key


async def test_a_node_reflashed_with_a_key_of_its_own_after_the_hub_kept_one_can_be_paired_with_the_new_key(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, node: FakeNode, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    """Paired with the Hub's key, unpaired (the Hub keeps the device record, and so the key), then reflashed with a key
    in its YAML: the kept key is refused, so the user must be able to enter the new one."""
    found = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(keyless=True))
    await hub_creates_device(controller.platform, found)
    await controller.pair_device(found, credentials=None)
    kept = (await stored(controller, found.id)).integration_data.encryption_key
    await controller.unpair(await stored(controller, found.id))
    node.key = NEW_KEY

    again = await discover(controller, mdns, Advert(encrypted=True))

    assert again.expected_credentials_options == [CredentialsType.none, CredentialsType.secret]
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionError):  # the kept key is the wrong one now
        await controller.pair_device(again, credentials=None)
    assert "key" in (output.updated_discoveries[-1].last_error or "").lower()
    await controller.pair_device(
        controller.discoveries[again.id], ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.secret, value=NEW_KEY)
    )
    device = await stored(controller, found.id)
    assert device.integration_data.encryption_key == NEW_KEY != kept
    assert (device.available, device.last_error) == (True, None)
    assert node.set_key_sessions == [ZERO_NOISE_PSK], "a node with a key of its own is not given ours"


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_lifecycle.py
================================================================================
"""Controller lifecycle with a virtual ESPHome device: restarts, outages, shutdown."""

import asyncio

import pytest
from aioesphomeapi import APIClient
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import leaked_tasks, param, wait_for_value, wait_until
from tests.virtual.runner import VirtualDevice


async def stored_device(controller: ESPhomeController, device_id) -> ESPhomeDevice:
    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(device_id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    return stored


async def flip_relay(device: VirtualDevice):
    client = APIClient(device.address, device.port, "")
    await client.connect(login=True)
    try:
        entities, _ = await client.list_entities_services()
        client.switch_command(next(e.key for e in entities if e.name == "Relay"), True)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    finally:
        await client.disconnect()


@pytest.mark.timeout(60)
async def test_paired_devices_reconnect_when_the_hub_restarts(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await controller.stop()
    output.connected_devices.clear()
    output.events.clear()
    restarted = ESPhomeController(controller.platform)
    restarted.peripherals = controller.peripherals
    restarted.output = controller.output

    await restarted.start()
    try:
        await wait_until(lambda: paired.id in output.connected_devices, 15, "the paired device to reconnect")
        await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Temperature"))
        assert (await stored_device(restarted, paired.id)).available
    finally:
        await restarted.stop()


@pytest.mark.timeout(90)
async def test_outage_and_recovery_are_reported(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Temperature"))
    output.connected_devices.clear()

    await device.stop()
    await wait_until(lambda: paired.id in output.lost_devices, 15, "the outage to be reported")
    assert not (await stored_device(controller, paired.id)).available

    await device.start()
    await wait_until(lambda: paired.id in output.connected_devices, 40, "the recovery to be reported")
    recovered = await stored_device(controller, paired.id)
    assert recovered.available
    assert recovered.last_error is None
    output.events.clear()
    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Temperature"))


@pytest.mark.timeout(90)
async def test_startup_with_an_offline_device_does_not_block_and_recovers(
    controller: ESPhomeController,
    paired: ESPhomeDevice,
    device: VirtualDevice,
    output: RecordingControllerOutput,
):
    await controller.stop()
    await device.stop()
    output.connected_devices.clear()
    restarted = ESPhomeController(controller.platform)
    restarted.peripherals = controller.peripherals
    restarted.output = controller.output

    async with asyncio.timeout(5):
        await restarted.start()  # a dead device must not hold the Hub's startup
    try:
        await wait_until(lambda: paired.id not in output.connected_devices, 1)
        await _wait_unavailable(restarted, paired)
        assert (await stored_device(restarted, paired.id)).last_error

        await device.start()
        await wait_until(lambda: paired.id in output.connected_devices, 40, "the device to connect once it is up")
        assert (await stored_device(restarted, paired.id)).last_error is None
    finally:
        await restarted.stop()


async def _wait_unavailable(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice):
    deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + 20
    while asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < deadline:
        stored = await stored_device(controller, paired.id)
        if not stored.available:
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    raise TimeoutError("device never reported unavailable")


async def test_stop_closes_everything(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Temperature"))

    await controller.stop()
    output.events.clear()
    await flip_relay(device)
    await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

    assert output.events == []
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_unpair_stops_the_flow_of_events(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Temperature"))

    await controller.unpair(paired)
    output.events.clear()
    await flip_relay(device)
    await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

    assert output.events == []
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_identify_leaves_a_working_device(
    controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice, device: VirtualDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await controller.identify(paired)  # ESPHome has no identify action: it must be a harmless no-op

    await flip_relay(device)
    await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, "Relay"), lambda v: v is True)

# FILE: tests/test_pairing.py
================================================================================
"""Pairing against a virtual ESPHome device: what gets stored, and how pairing fails."""

import asyncio

import pytest
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas import CredentialsType, ProvidedCredentials
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.device import Discovery
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import (
    ParameterDataType as T,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import (
    ParameterRole as R,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import (
    ParameterUnit,
    ParameterVisibility,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import ROOM, assert_not_paired, leaked_tasks, param, wait_for_value
from tests.virtual.mdns import Advert, FakeMDNS
from tests.virtual.runner import VirtualDevice

# (entity name, sub-field) -> (data type, role): the parameters the Hub must see for the virtual device
EXPECTED_PARAMETERS: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[T, R]] = {
    ("Relay", "state"): (T.bool, R.control),
    ("Virtual Fan", "state"): (T.bool, R.control),
    ("Virtual Light", "state"): (T.bool, R.control),
    ("Virtual Light", "brightness"): (T.decimal, R.control),  # brightness-only light: no colour channels
    ("RGB Light", "state"): (T.bool, R.control),
    ("RGB Light", "brightness"): (T.decimal, R.control),
    ("RGB Light", "color_hue"): (T.decimal, R.control),  # colour as hue and saturation, like Matter and Zigbee
    ("RGB Light", "color_saturation"): (T.decimal, R.control),
    ("Virtual Light", "transition_length"): (T.decimal, R.control),  # a setting kept by the integration
    ("Virtual Light", "flash"): (T.struct, R.control),  # a command with its length as argument
    ("RGB Light", "transition_length"): (T.decimal, R.control),
    ("RGB Light", "flash"): (T.struct, R.control),
    ("Blinds", "position"): (T.decimal, R.control),
    ("Blinds", "operation"): (T.enum, R.sensor),
    ("Blinds", "stop"): (T.none, R.control),
    ("Virtual Fan", "speed_level"): (T.integer, R.control),
    ("Virtual Fan", "oscillating"): (T.bool, R.control),
    ("Virtual Fan", "direction"): (T.enum, R.control),
    ("HVAC", "action"): (T.enum, R.sensor),
    ("HVAC", "custom_preset"): (T.enum, R.control),
    ("HVAC", "mode"): (T.enum, R.control),
    ("HVAC", "current_temperature"): (T.decimal, R.sensor),
    ("HVAC", "target_temperature_low"): (T.decimal, R.control),  # the thermostat is two-point
    ("HVAC", "target_temperature_high"): (T.decimal, R.control),
    ("Target Temp", "state"): (T.decimal, R.control),
    ("Mode", "state"): (T.enum, R.control),
    ("Reboot", "state"): (T.none, R.control),
    ("Temperature", "state"): (T.decimal, R.sensor),
    ("Humidity", "state"): (T.decimal, R.sensor),
    ("Dust", "state"): (T.decimal, R.sensor),
    ("Distance", "state"): (T.decimal, R.sensor),
    ("Motion", "state"): (T.bool, R.sensor),
    ("Status", "state"): (T.string, R.sensor),
}


async def test_pairing_exposes_exactly_the_capabilities_of_each_entity(paired: ESPhomeDevice):
    actual = {
        (p.integration_data.entity_name, p.integration_data.sub_field): (p.data_type, p.role) for p in paired.parameters
    }

    assert actual == EXPECTED_PARAMETERS


async def test_parameter_metadata_comes_from_the_device(paired: ESPhomeDevice):
    target = param(paired, "Target Temp")
    assert (target.min_value, target.max_value, target.min_step) == (10, 30, 0.5)
    assert param(paired, "Temperature").unit == ParameterUnit.celsius
    assert param(paired, "Humidity").unit == ParameterUnit.percentage
    assert param(paired, "Dust").unit == ParameterUnit.ugm3
    assert param(paired, "Distance").unit == ParameterUnit.meters
    # enums are integers with string labels (`valid_values`), labelled by the enum names like the other integrations
    assert param(paired, "Mode").valid_values == {0: "AUTO", 1: "MANUAL"}
    assert param(paired, "Blinds", "operation").valid_values == {0: "IDLE", 1: "IS_OPENING", 2: "IS_CLOSING"}
    assert param(paired, "HVAC", "mode").valid_values == {0: "OFF", 2: "COOL", 3: "HEAT"}  # the modes it supports
    # levels, positions and colour channels are percentages, as everywhere in MajorDom (ESPHome reports 0-1)
    for entity, sub_field in [
        ("Virtual Light", "brightness"),
        ("RGB Light", "color_saturation"),
        ("Blinds", "position"),
    ]:
        level = param(paired, entity, sub_field)
        assert (level.unit, level.min_value, level.max_value) == (ParameterUnit.percentage, 0, 100), entity
    hue = param(paired, "RGB Light", "color_hue")
    assert (hue.unit, hue.min_value, hue.max_value) == (ParameterUnit.arcdegree, 0, 360)


async def test_the_remaining_fields_are_settings_with_the_limits_the_entity_reports(paired: ESPhomeDevice):
    speed = param(paired, "Virtual Fan", "speed_level")
    assert (speed.min_value, speed.max_value) == (0, 3)  # speed_count: 3
    assert param(paired, "Virtual Fan", "direction").valid_values == {0: "FORWARD", 1: "REVERSE"}
    assert param(paired, "HVAC", "custom_preset").valid_values == {0: "Default"}  # the presets the thermostat has
    extras = [("Blinds", "stop"), ("Virtual Fan", "oscillating"), ("HVAC", "action"), ("Virtual Fan", "direction")]
    for entity, sub_field in extras:
        assert param(paired, entity, sub_field).visibility == ParameterVisibility.setting, (entity, sub_field)
    assert param(paired, "Relay").visibility == ParameterVisibility.user  # the hand-written parameters stay on top
    assert not [p for p in paired.parameters if p.integration_data.sub_field == "tilt"]  # the blinds cannot tilt


async def test_identity_is_derived_through_the_sdk_helpers(controller: ESPhomeController, paired: ESPhomeDevice):
    assert paired.id == controller.device_uuid("983569abf679")
    for parameter in paired.parameters:
        key = (
            f"{parameter.integration_data.entity_name.lower().replace(' ', '_')}_{parameter.integration_data.sub_field}"
        )
        assert parameter.id == controller.parameter_uuid(paired.id, key)


async def test_device_has_a_one_tap_main_parameter(paired: ESPhomeDevice):
    main = next((p for p in paired.parameters if p.id == paired.main_parameter), None)

    assert main is not None, "main_parameter must reference one of the device's parameters"
    assert main.can_be_main_parameter


async def test_pairing_keeps_what_the_hub_already_knows_about_the_device(
    controller: ESPhomeController, discovery: Discovery
):
    await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    assert (stored.room_id, stored.name) == (ROOM, "Kitchen relay")  # the user's choices, saved by the Hub


async def test_pairing_needs_the_device_the_hub_creates(controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, device):
    await mdns.announce(Advert(port=device.port))
    (discovery,) = controller.discoveries.values()

    with pytest.raises(LookupError):
        await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        assert await repo.get(discovery.id) is None  # the integration must not invent the device


async def test_pairing_reports_the_device_and_forgets_the_discovery(
    controller: ESPhomeController, discovery: Discovery, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)

    assert output.connected_devices == [discovery.id]
    assert controller.discoveries == {}


async def test_pairing_accepts_explicit_no_credentials(controller: ESPhomeController, discovery: Discovery):
    await controller.pair_device(discovery, ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.none))


async def test_pairing_rejects_credentials_the_discovery_did_not_ask_for(
    controller: ESPhomeController, discovery: Discovery
):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        await controller.pair_device(discovery, ProvidedCredentials(type=CredentialsType.secret, value="a-key"))

    assert discovery.id in controller.discoveries


async def test_device_can_be_paired_again_after_unpairing(
    controller: ESPhomeController, mdns: FakeMDNS, device: VirtualDevice, paired: ESPhomeDevice
):
    await controller.unpair(paired)
    await mdns.announce(Advert(name="test_node", port=device.port, addresses=["127.0.0.1", "::1"]))
    (discovery,) = controller.discoveries.values()

    await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        again = await repo.get(discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert again is not None
    assert [p.id for p in again.parameters] == [p.id for p in paired.parameters]


@pytest.mark.timeout(60)
async def test_pairing_an_unreachable_device_fails_fast_and_cleanly(
    controller: ESPhomeController, discovery: Discovery, device: VirtualDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await device.stop()

    async with asyncio.timeout(25):
        with pytest.raises((ConnectionError, TimeoutError)):
            await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)

    await assert_not_paired(controller.platform, discovery.id)
    assert output.connected_devices == []
    assert output.updated_discoveries[-1].last_error, "the user must see why pairing failed"
    assert discovery.id in controller.discoveries
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    assert leaked_tasks() == []


async def test_pairing_is_retryable_after_the_device_comes_back(
    controller: ESPhomeController, discovery: Discovery, device: VirtualDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await device.stop()
    with pytest.raises((ConnectionError, TimeoutError)):
        await controller.pair_device(discovery, credentials=None)
    await device.start()

    await controller.pair_device(output.updated_discoveries[-1], credentials=None)

    async with controller.platform.device_repository(controller) as repo:
        stored = await repo.get(discovery.id, as_=ESPhomeDevice)
    assert stored is not None
    assert stored.last_error is None
    await wait_for_value(output, param(stored, "Temperature"))

# FILE: tests/test_state.py
================================================================================
"""Device -> Hub: states pushed by a virtual ESPHome device become typed parameter events."""

import pytest
from aioesphomeapi import APIClient
from majordom_integration_sdk.testing import RecordingControllerOutput

from majordom_esphome.controller import ESPhomeController
from majordom_esphome.models import ESPhomeDevice
from tests.helpers import assert_values_match_parameters, changes, param, values, wait_for_value, wait_until
from tests.virtual.runner import VirtualDevice


@pytest.fixture
async def settled(paired: ESPhomeDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput) -> ESPhomeDevice:
    """Paired device whose initial states have all arrived."""
    for entity in ("Temperature", "Humidity", "Dust", "Distance", "Motion", "Status", "Target Temp", "Mode"):
        await wait_for_value(output, param(paired, entity))
    return paired


async def test_initial_states_are_reported_with_device_values(
    settled: ESPhomeDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    expected = {"Temperature": 21.5, "Humidity": 55.0, "Dust": 12.0, "Distance": 1.5, "Motion": True, "Status": "OK"}

    for entity, value in expected.items():
        assert values(output, param(settled, entity).id)[-1] == value, entity
    assert values(output, param(settled, "Target Temp").id)[-1] == 10.0
    assert values(output, param(settled, "Mode").id)[-1] == 0  # "AUTO": enums are reported as their index


async def test_every_value_has_the_type_its_parameter_declares(
    settled: ESPhomeDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    await wait_for_value(output, param(settled, "HVAC", "mode"))
    await wait_for_value(output, param(settled, "Blinds", "operation"))

    assert_values_match_parameters(output, settled)


async def test_two_point_climate_reports_both_targets(settled: ESPhomeDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput):
    low = await wait_for_value(output, param(settled, "HVAC", "target_temperature_low"))
    high = await wait_for_value(output, param(settled, "HVAC", "target_temperature_high"))

    assert low < high


async def test_changes_made_on_the_device_are_pushed(
    settled: ESPhomeDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput, device: VirtualDevice
):
    relay = param(settled, "Relay")
    client = APIClient(device.address, device.port, "")
    await client.connect(login=True)
    try:
        entities, _ = await client.list_entities_services()
        relay_key = next(e.key for e in entities if e.name == "Relay")

        client.switch_command(relay_key, True)

        assert await wait_for_value(output, relay, lambda v: v is True)
    finally:
        await client.disconnect()


async def test_fetch_reports_the_current_value_of_every_readable_parameter(
    controller: ESPhomeController, settled: ESPhomeDevice, output: RecordingControllerOutput
):
    output.events.clear()

    await controller.fetch(settled)

    reported = {e.parameter_id for e in changes(output)}
    for entity in ("Temperature", "Humidity", "Dust", "Distance", "Motion", "Status", "Target Temp", "Mode"):
        assert param(settled, entity).id in reported, entity
    assert_values_match_parameters(output, settled)


async def test_fetch_reports_in_one_batch(controller: ESPhomeController, settled: ESPhomeDevice, output):
    batches: list[int] = []
    original = output.controller_did_receive_events

    async def spy(controller, events):
        events = list(events)
        batches.append(len(events))
        await original(controller, events)

    output.controller_did_receive_events = spy  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    await wait_until(lambda: True)
    batches.clear()

    await controller.fetch(settled)

    assert len(batches) == 1 and batches[0] >= 8


================================================================================
# FILE: tests/test_unhosted_fields.py
================================================================================
"""Fields no virtual node can exercise, tested on library objects built directly (not end to end).

The host thermostat has no custom fan modes, so a climate with some cannot be hosted. The mapping of such a field is
still checked here: the parameter an entity description produces, the value a state maps to, and the command a value
becomes, with the same functions the controller calls.
"""

from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest
from aioesphomeapi import (
    ClimateInfo,
    ClimateMode,
    ClimateState,
    EntityInfo,
    LightInfo,
    LockCommand,
    LockInfo,
    UpdateInfo,
    WaterHeaterInfo,
    WaterHeaterState,
)
from majordom_integration_sdk.schemas.parameter import (
    ParameterDataType,
    ParameterRole,
    ParameterUnit,
    ParameterVisibility,
)

from majordom_esphome import mapper
from majordom_esphome.models import (
    ESPhomeParameter,
    ESPhomeParameterIntegrationData,
    ESPhomeParameterType,
    ParameterSpec,
)

# the library's dataclasses are not typed for construction
Info: Any = ClimateInfo
State: Any = ClimateState


def thermostat(**kwargs: Any) -> EntityInfo:
    return Info(
        object_id="probe",
        key=77,
        name="Probe",
        supported_modes=[ClimateMode.OFF, ClimateMode.HEAT],
        supports_two_point_target_temperature=False,
        **kwargs,
    )


def spec_of(entity: EntityInfo, sub_field: str) -> ParameterSpec | None:
    component = mapper.component_type_of(entity)
    assert component is not None
    return next((s for s in mapper.parameter_specs(entity, component) if s.sub_field == sub_field), None)


def parameter_of(entity: EntityInfo, spec: ParameterSpec) -> ESPhomeParameter:
    return ESPhomeParameter(
        id=uuid4(),
        name=spec.sub_field,
        data_type=spec.data_type,
        role=spec.role,
        visibility=spec.visibility or ParameterVisibility.user,
        valid_values=spec.valid_values,
        min_value=spec.min_value,
        max_value=spec.max_value,
        fields=[parameter_of(entity, child) for child in spec.fields] or None,
        integration_data=ESPhomeParameterIntegrationData(
            entity_name=entity.name,
            object_id=entity.object_id,
            component_type=mapper.component_type_of(entity) or "",
            parameter_type=ESPhomeParameterType.STATE,
            service_key=entity.key,
            sub_field=spec.sub_field,
        ),
    )


def test_custom_fan_modes_become_an_enum_of_the_offered_modes():
    spec = spec_of(thermostat(supported_custom_fan_modes=["Breeze", "Gust"]), "custom_fan_mode")

    assert spec is not None
    assert (spec.data_type, spec.role) == (ParameterDataType.enum, ParameterRole.control)
    assert spec.valid_values == {0: "Breeze", 1: "Gust"}
    assert spec.visibility == ParameterVisibility.setting


def test_no_custom_fan_modes_no_parameter():
    assert spec_of(thermostat(), "custom_fan_mode") is None


def test_a_custom_fan_mode_state_is_reported_as_the_index_of_the_option():
    entity = thermostat(supported_custom_fan_modes=["Breeze", "Gust"])

    assert mapper.state_values(entity, State(key=77, custom_fan_mode="Gust"))["custom_fan_mode"] == 1
    assert "custom_fan_mode" not in mapper.state_values(entity, State(key=77, custom_fan_mode=""))  # none set


def test_a_custom_fan_mode_command_sends_the_option_name():
    entity = thermostat(supported_custom_fan_modes=["Breeze", "Gust"])
    spec = spec_of(entity, "custom_fan_mode")
    assert spec is not None
    parameter = parameter_of(entity, spec)

    assert mapper.build_command_args(parameter, 1, {}) == {"key": 77, "custom_fan_mode": "Gust"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        mapper.build_command_args(parameter, 5, {})


def test_a_lock_that_requires_a_code_offers_a_command_with_the_code_and_a_default_code():
    lock: Any = LockInfo
    entity = lock(object_id="door", key=5, name="Door", requires_code=True)
    spec = spec_of(entity, "command_with_code")
    default = spec_of(entity, "code")
    assert spec is not None and default is not None
    assert spec.data_type == ParameterDataType.struct  # a command with arguments: fields of a struct
    assert [child.sub_field for child in spec.fields] == ["command", "code"]
    assert (default.data_type, default.visibility, default.local) == (
        ParameterDataType.string,
        ParameterVisibility.setting,
        True,
    )
    parameter = parameter_of(entity, spec)
    command, code = parameter.fields or []

    typed = mapper.build_command_args(parameter, {str(command.id): 1, str(code.id): "1234"}, {}, {"code": "9999"})
    fallback = mapper.build_command_args(parameter, {str(command.id): 1}, {}, {"code": "9999"})
    without = mapper.build_command_args(parameter, {str(command.id): 1}, {})

    assert typed == {"key": 5, "command": LockCommand.LOCK, "code": "1234"}  # a typed code wins
    assert fallback == {"key": 5, "command": LockCommand.LOCK, "code": "9999"}  # else the kept default
    assert without == {"key": 5, "command": LockCommand.LOCK}  # else none: the lock decides
    plain = spec_of(entity, "command")
    assert plain is not None
    assert mapper.build_command_args(parameter_of(entity, plain), 0, {}, {"code": "9999"}) == {
        "key": 5,
        "command": LockCommand.UNLOCK,
        "code": "9999",
    }
    assert spec_of(lock(object_id="door", key=5, name="Door", requires_code=False), "command_with_code") is None
    assert spec_of(lock(object_id="door", key=5, name="Door", requires_code=False), "code") is None


def test_water_heater_flags_are_switches_of_the_state_bit_mask():
    heater: Any = WaterHeaterInfo
    state: Any = WaterHeaterState
    entity = heater(object_id="boiler", key=9, name="Boiler", supported_features=8 | 16)  # away, on/off
    on, away = spec_of(entity, "on"), spec_of(entity, "away")
    assert on is not None and away is not None
    assert (on.data_type, on.role) == (ParameterDataType.bool, ParameterRole.control)

    assert {k: v for k, v in mapper.state_values(entity, state(key=9, state=2)).items() if k in ("on", "away")} == {
        "on": True,
        "away": False,
    }
    assert mapper.build_command_args(parameter_of(entity, on), False, {}) == {"key": 9, "on": False}
    assert spec_of(heater(object_id="boiler", key=9, name="Boiler", supported_features=0), "away") is None


def test_the_colour_brightness_is_only_offered_where_colour_and_white_mix():
    light: Any = LightInfo
    rgb_only = light(object_id="l", key=1, name="L", supported_color_modes=[35])  # RGB
    rgbw = light(object_id="l", key=1, name="L", supported_color_modes=[39])  # RGB + WHITE

    assert spec_of(rgb_only, "color_brightness") is None
    assert spec_of(rgbw, "color_brightness") is not None


def test_firmware_update_parameters_are_hidden():
    update: Any = UpdateInfo
    specs = mapper.parameter_specs(update(object_id="fw", key=3, name="Firmware"), "update")

    assert specs, "an update entity is still mapped"
    assert {spec.visibility for spec in specs} == {ParameterVisibility.system}


def test_water_heater_temperatures_are_in_celsius():
    heater: Any = WaterHeaterInfo
    entity = heater(object_id="boiler", key=9, name="Boiler", supported_features=1 | 2)  # current and target

    for field in ("current_temperature", "target_temperature"):
        spec = spec_of(entity, field)
        assert spec is not None and spec.unit == ParameterUnit.celsius, field


def test_a_two_point_water_heater_offers_low_and_high_targets_within_its_limits():
    heater: Any = WaterHeaterInfo
    entity = heater(
        object_id="boiler", key=9, name="Boiler", supported_features=2 | 32, min_temperature=30.0, max_temperature=70.0
    )  # target temperature, two-point

    assert spec_of(entity, "target_temperature") is None
    for field in ("target_temperature_low", "target_temperature_high"):
        spec = spec_of(entity, field)
        assert spec is not None and (spec.min_value, spec.max_value) == (30.0, 70.0), field
